jobs.description:
Over the past 30 years, we’ve grown from humble beginnings with a single computer into a diversified, global, technology-enabled lottery and prize draw company (ASX: JIN). Today, Jumbo operates across Australia, the UK, Canada and the US, bringing together technology, creativity and purpose to create premium digital experiences people love.

Based in Galgate, StarVale is dedicated to strengthening the fundraising power of charities, not‑for‑profits, and hospices across the UK. We combine specialist lottery management with a genuine commitment to helping organisations maximise their impact, so more communities receive the support they deserve.

What will you be doing?

We’re looking for a .NET Web Developer to join us in this hands‑on build‑and‑migrate role. You will be rewriting existing PHP websites in .NET, integrating them with our business systems, and helping shape how we structure our shared architecture going forward. Working closely with cross‑functional teams, you will support day‑to‑day business needs, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to high‑quality engineering practices through code reviews, documentation, and collaborative solution design.

What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Your daily work will centre on maintaining, modernising, and progressively transforming our legacy .NET systems while supporting the smooth running of core business operations across StarVale. You can expect to:

Design and build ASP.NET Core websites targeting modern .NET versions (including .NET 10)
Migrate Laravel and CodeIgniter sites to the .NET platform while preserving functionality, SEO, and data integrity
Work with Umbraco CMS — extending existing implementations or building new sites where appropriate
Integrate websites with core .NET business systems and SQL Server databases
Write and maintain EF Core data access code, including migrating data from MySQL to SQL Server
Document business logic and edge cases from existing PHP sites before decommissioning
Contribute to shared architecture decisions, internal libraries, and coding standards
Write clean, tested, maintainable code and participate in code reviews

What You’ll Be Able to Bring to the Role

Essential

Solid commercial experience with C# and ASP.NET Core (or strong ASP.NET MVC experience with a clear path to Core)
Experience with Entity Framework Core (or EF) and relational databases (SQL Server)
Comfortable working with front-end fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) alongside server-rendered .NET views or Razor Pages
Experience migrating or integrating systems between different platforms or frameworks
Ability to read and understand PHP (Laravel and/or CodeIgniter) well enough to translate existing functionality into .NET — you won't be writing new PHP, but you'll need to understand what's there
Good understanding of web fundamentals: routing, authentication, forms, SEO basics (URL structure, redirects)

Mindset & Soft Skills

Migration Mindset: Confidence to evaluate legacy code, challenge outdated practices, and guide non-technical stakeholders through modernized technical solutions.
Problem Solver: Highly resourceful with strong initiative, able to own projects independently from requirements-gathering to deployment.
Communication: Excellent people skills to liaise effectively between technical teams, external auditors, and cross-departmental stakeholders.

Preferred:

Experience with Umbraco CMS
Experience with Blazor
Familiarity with Azure or other cloud hosting for .NET applications
Experience leading or contributing to a platform migration or legacy system modernization
Understanding of REST API design, for connecting websites to internal business systems
Ability to work within agile environments, including Kanban and Sprints.

Salary Banding: £35,000–£45,000 per annum, depending on experience.

Our Ways of Working

At StarVale, we value balance and flexibility. You will be based in our office in Galgate, Lancaster. This role is a flexible hybrid, typically averaging 50% in the office (2-3 days per week). We prioritise results and collaborate to make sure everyone can contribute effectively, while enjoying flexibility and balance in how they work.

Why Join StarVale?

Find Your Freedom - https://bit.ly/Jumbointeractive

At StarVale, our team thrives because we invest in our people. Here’s what you can expect from us;

An annual regional bonus scheme that rewards your contributions, dependent on company performance.
25 days annual leave + public holidays + your birthday off.
Access to our Employee Assistance Program, providing counselling and coaching.
Reward & Recognition programme and length of service benefits.
The freedom to work from almost* anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks a year.

Candidates who are offered a position will be required to complete pre-employment checks through our partner, Checkmate, which will include referencing, Right to Work in the UK and DBS checks. We are, unfortunately, unable to offer sponsorship opportunities.

About Us

Renaissance® is a global leader in education technology. We help schools and school groups in the UK and around the world with educational assessments, practice and intervention solutions, and data analytics. Renaissance now incorporates GL Assessment (known internationally as GL Education), too – a leading provider of educational assessments.

Together, our assessments offer the ideal starting point to help teachers understand their students’ strengths and pinpoint areas of need. Our teaching and learning tools then provide effective next steps, with online literacy and maths solutions that meet students exactly where we are.

Worldwide, we support over 18 million students, operating in over 100 countries.

Do you want to help millions of students worldwide reach their potential?

At Renaissance, we build technology that accelerates learning for millions of students globally - regardless of ability, background, or circumstance. Our assessment platform helps teachers make data-driven decisions that change lives.

We're a tech-for-good company where people come first. We believe great software comes from great teams, and we're looking for Software Engineers who want to combine technical craft with meaningful impact.

The Role

You'll work on high-scale global EdTech systems (Azure, .NET, Angular) that process assessment data for millions of students worldwide, and join a collaborative agile team with autonomy, high engineering standards, and a focus on continuous improvement.

What Makes This Different

Craft matters - We value clean code, a quality mindset, and engineering excellence
Trust and support - Teams make technical decisions collaboratively with mentorship when you need it
Real impact - Your work helps teachers make better decisions for their students
Help build our AI-first future - We're early in the process of adopting agentic SDLC, you'll help define how we integrate AI into our workflows

What You'll Do

Design, build, and maintain features across the full stack (Azure, .NET APIs, Angular frontend, SQL databases)
Make or contribute to architectural and technical decisions within your domain
Write clean, tested, maintainable code that solves real problems

jobs.description:
Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, loyalty and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.

While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within NI.

Your new role

In this role, you’ll join as a Software Engineer on the ‘ BrandX’ team, which is part of the wider ‘ Order Engineering ’ group.

BrandX (Brand Experience) builds the tools restaurant brands and Olo's internal teams use to run their business on Olo. We own the Dashboard that brand operators log into every day, the internal Admin application, and the billing and invoicing systems that turn platform usage into invoices. We also own how brands sign in and manage their users, including SSO and two-factor authentication, and we are building Olo AI Assist, a natural-language assistant inside the Dashboard.

The team is seven engineers spread across the US and Europe, and you'd be our first hire in Northern Ireland. Because the team sits between brands, Finance, and the rest of Order Engineering, the work is varied. One week you might be shipping a new Dashboard settings page, the next you're tracing a billing discrepancy across our finance integrations or teaching Olo AI Assist a new skill so a brand can update hours across hundreds of stores just by asking. You'll pair with senior engineers, review and ship code most days, and use Claude Code as a normal part of how you work.

How you’ll make an impact

Learn the BrandX domain and technology stack, and get to know the brands, Finance partners, and Order Engineering teams we work with.
Own small-to-medium features end to end, from understanding the requirement to shipping it, with senior engineers available when you need them.
Write code that meets our standards, and participate in code reviews as both author and reviewer.
Build reliable and maintainable software, with test coverage that matches the risk of the change.
Contribute to the team’s delivery pipeline, including test coverage, CI, and deployment practices.
Use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as your default way of building, and help the team push what these tools can do.
Troubleshoot and debug production issues, learning how our systems fit together along the way.
Participate in team ceremonies such as daily stand-ups and retrospectives, sharing updates and feedback.
Take part in learning activities, including game days and training sessions, to build familiarity with Olo’s tools and processes.
Join the on-call rotation, with responsibilities that grow as you learn the team’s systems.

What will set you up for success

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
1 to 3 years of professional software engineering experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped projects.
Working knowledge of C# and .NET, and comfort reading code you didn't write.
Some experience building web UIs. We use React and TypeScript, but any modern framework is a fine starting point.
Comfortable with SQL and relational data. A lot of our work is understanding how data moves between systems.
You understand the difference between unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and when each one earns its place.
AI coding agents are your default way of working. You use tools like Claude Code daily, you can explain the fundamentals underneath what they generate, and you're excited about a team that expects you to push them further.
You ask questions early, write things down, and are comfortable working with colleagues in other time zones.

About Olo

Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source—so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. Over 800 restaurant brands trust Olo and its network of more than 400 integration partners to innovate on behalf of the restaurant community, accelerating technology’s positive impact and creating a world where every restaurant guest feels like a regular. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working across the whole stack and is equally comfortable building conventional services and AI-enabled features. You will work alongside architects, product stakeholders and delivery partners to ship software that brokers and analysts use every day.

Key Responsibilities

Build Across the Stack: Design, build and ship features end to end, from APIs and services through to responsive, accessible user interfaces.
Cloud Native Delivery: Develop and run cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, using PaaS services, containers and infrastructure-as-code.

AI-Enabled Development: Build AI-enabled product features using patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool and API integration, evaluation and human-in-the-loop design.
AI-Assisted Engineering: Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code or Claude Cowork as part of your day-to-day workflow, and help the wider team adopt them well.
Integration: Integrate with external market platforms, carrier and client systems, and vendor SaaS products using API-first and event-driven patterns.
Quality & Security: Practise test-driven development and write secure, maintainable code, applying established security patterns including authentication and authorisation (Entra ID, OAuth 2.0), data protection and privacy from the start.
Collaboration: Build to the agreed architectural standards and help shape them, contributing to design discussions, reviewing code from in-house and partner engineers, and mentoring others across a greenfield estate.

About You

You are a pragmatic, hands-on engineer who enjoys a fast-moving, greenfield environment and wants to work across both traditional and AI-native development. Ideally you will bring:

Experience: Extensive experience of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and supporting production systems end to end. Experience in insurance, reinsurance or wider financial services is a plus, but not essential.
Backend: Strong programming skills in C#/.NET or Python, with solid API design and strong SQL.
Frontend: Practical experience building modern user interfaces with React or Angular and TypeScript.
Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with Azure, CI/CD tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Standards & Security: Experience building to architectural standards and applying common patterns such as microservices, event-driven and API-led design, together with a strong grounding in security patterns (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, Entra ID, RBAC) and secure coding practices.
Data: Comfortable working with relational databases and data-heavy application features, with strong SQL and an eye for query performance.
AI Development: Experience building with LLMs and AI-enabled solutions, or a clear appetite to learn. Familiarity with agentic patterns, prompt design and evaluation is a significant advantage.
Engineering Craft: Fluency in test-driven development and automated testing, an eye for maintainable design, and good judgement about when to keep things simple.
Communication: Ability to work closely with product stakeholders and delivery partners, and to explain technical trade-offs clearly.

About Willis Re

We combine specialist broking with analytics, modeling and research to help insurers optimize risk transfer, strengthen balance sheets and achieve sustainable growth. Our approach is relationship-driven, transparent and outcome-focused.

At the heart of Willis Re is a focus on delivering the most cutting-edge analytical solutions to enable more informed, better decision-making for risk selection, portfolio optimization, and capital management.

The launch of Willis Re brings a strategic advantage of being unhindered by legacy, an ability to leverage data, statistical models and advanced technologies with the best knowledge and expertise to deliver more efficient and effective reinsurance outcomes. This places Willis Re in a unique position to build a truly analytically driven business, focused on creating solutions for the reinsurance industry that are future led and forward thinking.

Willis Re will also leverage recognized technical expertise from WTW’s Insurance Consulting & Technology business including their advanced modeling and analytical capabilities. jobs.title: Software Architect - .NET / Warehouse Automation
jobs.description:
WCS Software Architect

Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Software Architect
to play a key role in shaping and evolving a mission-critical Warehouse Control System (WCS)
used in highly automated logistics environments. This platform sits at the heart of real-time operations, orchestrating material flow across conveyor systems, integrating with PLC controls, robotics (AMR/AGV), and upstream enterprise platforms such as WMS and ERP.
This is a highly technical position where you will set architectural direction, make critical design decisions, and remain close to the code and engineering challenges
. You will work alongside an existing architecture function to scale capability as the platform transitions to a modern .NET / Blazor-based ecosystem
from its current Python/Django foundation.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Leadership

Define and evolve the architecture across application, data, messaging, and deployment layers
Lead the design of complex features and subsystems, producing clear design artefacts and architecture documentation (including ADRs)
Make key technical decisions across persistence, messaging, caching, and integration patterns
Ensure solutions meet non-functional requirements including performance, scalability, availability, and security
Troubleshoot and resolve complex system issues, including concurrency, bottlenecks, and integration failures

Systems Integration

Own and define integration patterns between the WCS platform and external systems including PLCs, WMS, ERP, and robotics platforms

Design robust, scalable messaging and API-based interfaces
Ensure resilience through clear contract definitions, error handling, and recovery strategies
Support emulation and pre-deployment validation approaches to reduce risk

Client-Facing & Delivery Support

Act as a technical authority in client workshops, design reviews, FAT/SAT, and commissioning phases

Provide support during go-live activities, including system tuning, troubleshooting, and stabilisation
Collaborate with delivery and project teams to ensure integration success
Maintain a calm, solution-focused approach in high-pressure live environments

Technology Strategy & Governance

Contribute to architectural standards, coding guidelines, and design governance
Evaluate new tools and technologies, making evidence-based recommendations
Ensure alignment between business requirements, architecture decisions, and delivered solutions
Drive best practices across performance, observability, and system resilience

Collaboration & Mentoring

Work closely with product, development, test, and controls engineering teams
Provide visibility of architectural direction, risks, and readiness to stakeholders
Mentor and support engineers, raising overall technical capability within the team
Promote a culture of high-quality engineering and continuous improvement

Skills & Experience Required

Proven experience as a Software Architect
or a senior/lead engineer stepping into architecture
Strong expertise in C# / .NET
and modern application development practices
Experience designing distributed systems, microservices, and high-performance applications

Solid background in system integration (APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture)

Exposure to industrial systems, warehouse automation, WCS/WMS, or similar environments

Experience working with PLCs, robotics, or real-time control systems (desirable)

Knowledge of CI/CD, containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes), and Linux-based environments

Strong problem-solving ability, with experience in performance tuning and scalability challenges
Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Working Environment

Fully remote role with flexibility in working patterns
Involvement in occasional onsite activities
during key project phases such as system go-lives and commissioning
Collaborative, engineering-led environment focused on delivering high-quality, real-world solutions
Opportunity to work on a platform undergoing significant modernisation and growth

What We're Looking For

A hands-on technical leader who takes ownership of architectural outcomes
Someone pragmatic, detail-oriented, and confident in making decisions
A strong collaborator who can work across disciplines and teams
An individual who can balance long-term architectural vision with delivery priorities
A professional who thrives in complex, real-time, integration-heavy environments

Desired Skills and Experience

Software Architecture, .NET Development, C# Programming, System Design, Microservices Architecture, API Development, System Integration, Event-Driven Architecture, Distributed Systems, Warehouse Automation, WCS (Warehouse Control Systems), WMS (Warehouse Management Systems), Industrial Automation, PLC Integration, Robotics Integration (AGV/AMR), Messaging Systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ), Blazor, ASP.NET, Python, Django, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Performance Optimisation, Concurrency, Scalability, Technical Leadership, Stakeholder Engagement, Commissioning & Go-Live Support

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Ascent has recently been acquired by Acuity Analytics . This is both a significant milestone for us and a tremendous opportunity for you.

About the Role

You will be responsible for assessing complex existing application and integration landscapes, particularly Microsoft technology-based estates, identifying modernization opportunities, and designing scalable, resilient, secure, maintainable and cloud-agnostic target solutions aligned to business capabilities and enterprise architecture standards.
You will bring strong functional understanding and technical depth to translate business workflows, operating processes, integration dependencies, data flows, control points, reporting requirements and non-functional needs into practical modernization blueprints. The role involves defining migration-ready architecture patterns across .NET, C#, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure and related Microsoft-based technologies, evaluating technology options, guiding engineering teams, and ensuring solutions address scalability, availability, disaster recovery, RPO/RTO, security, auditability, observability, operational resilience and long-term supportability.

Skills and Experience Required

Core Skills (must-have):

Enterprise Solution Architecture
Application Legacy Modernization
Cloud-Agnostic Architecture
Microservices
Kafka / Event-Driven Architecture
Kubernetes
API & Integration Modernization
HA/DR design
DevSecOps / GitOps

Nice to Have:

Financial Services / Capital Markets domain experience
DORA / operational resilience awareness

Key Competencies:

Strong enterprise solution architecture experience in large-scale legacy modernization, application transformation, distributed systems, financial services platforms or high-volume transaction processing environments.
Ability to assess legacy estates including monolithic applications, tightly coupled integrations, shared databases, batch workflows, reporting platforms, operational bottlenecks and technology obsolescence risks.
Ability to understand business capabilities, functional workflows, operating models, reporting needs, controls, data dependencies and user journeys, and translate them into executable modernization solutions.
Deep understanding of microservices, domain-driven design, API design, database-per-service, event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging and enterprise integration design patterns.
Hands-on knowledge of Kafka or equivalent event streaming platforms, IBM MQ, REST, gRPC, FIX, SFTP, schema registry, message transformation, replayability, retry, exception handling and reconciliation patterns.
Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, container orchestration, cloud-native deployment, CI/CD, GitOps, Terraform, secrets management and DevSecOps engineering practices.
Good working knowledge of Azure and/or GCP cloud services, cloud landing zones, networking, identity, security, observability, resilience and workload deployment patterns.
Hands-on exposure to Azure architecture and Microsoft-based modernization patterns, including App Services, AKS, Azure SQL or SQL Server modernization, Entra ID, Key Vault, Azure Monitor and secure enterprise deployment practices.
Knowledge of cloud-agnostic architecture principles, multi-cloud deployment considerations, workload portability, exit strategy, high availability, disaster recovery, RPO/RTO definition and cross-environment resilience patterns.
Working knowledge of enterprise data platform concepts such as batch and streaming data flows, data quality, metadata, lineage, governance and regulatory data controls will be an advantage.
Strong understanding of Microsoft application landscapes including .NET, C#, WPF, Microsoft SQL Server, stored procedures, SSIS/SSRS awareness, Azure services, PostgreSQL, Redis, relational modelling, reporting platforms and approaches for modernizing legacy enterprise applications.
Experience defining migration approaches such as strangler pattern, phased cutover, parallel run, dual operation, output reconciliation, rollback design, hyper-care and legacy decommissioning.

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
TOGAF® Enterprise Architecture Practitioner

Lead enterprise solution architecture for legacy modernization initiatives covering business capabilities, application architecture, integration, data, cloud, security, DevSecOps, observability and operational supportability.

Understand business processes, user journeys, data flows, upstream/downstream dependencies, reporting needs, control requirements and operational pain points to shape fit-for-purpose enterprise solution designs.

Writing well-tested, maintainable production code.

.

.

Data structures, algorithms and problem solving.
Object-oriented design and software engineering principles.

SQL and relational databases.

Testing and production-quality engineering.
Taking an unclear problem, asking the right questions and shaping a sensible technical approach.

NoSQL databases
Docker and Kubernetes
CI/CD

AI-assisted coding tools

.

.

Location:
Oxfordshire

Hybrid

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
Location:
London, UK Experience Level:
15–20 Years Department:
Data & Technology Services

About Us

Ascent has recently been acquired by Acuity Analytics . This is both a significant milestone for us and a tremendous opportunity for you.

Acuity Analytics is a business with a strong global reputation, an impressive client base, and ambitious growth plans. We deliver deep insights and domain-led digital transformation to high-growth and heavily regulated organisations. To our customers, we bring a partnership that provides the talent, technology, and capability to enhance performance and operational efficiency.

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for an Enterprise Architect
to help shape the future of our engineering organisation and drive technical excellence across our modernization practice.

About the Role

This role is responsible for architecture assessment, target-state definition, and modernization alignment for complex enterprise application landscapes undergoing legacy transformation. You will focus on shaping scalable, resilient, secure, and governable architectures that progressively move monolithic, tightly coupled, batch-oriented systems toward modular, event-driven, cloud-enabled and operationally observable platforms.

The role requires strong hands-on architecture depth across application modernization, integration architecture, microservices, APIs, event streaming, container platforms, database modernization, DevSecOps, observability, resiliency, and governance. You will collaborate with business, application, data, infrastructure, security, DevOps, operations, and delivery teams to define transition roadmaps, manage architectural risks, establish guardrails, validate implementation choices, and ensure modernization is delivered through controlled, incremental, and enterprise-grade transformation practices.

Skills and Experience Required

Core Skills (must-have):

Enterprise Architecture
Legacy Modernization
Application Architecture
Microservices Architecture
Event-Driven Architecture
API & Integration Architecture
Cloud-Agnostic Architecture
Domain-Driven Design
Strangler Pattern Migration
DevSecOps
CI/CD & IaC
Observability
DataBricks
Data Governance & Lineage
Cloud Portability
Kubernetes
Kafka
.NET
MSSQL / PostgreSQL

Nice to Have:

Financial Services / Banking Domain experience

Key Competencies:

Proven enterprise architecture experience across large-scale legacy modernization, distributed systems, integration platforms, database ecosystems, cloud-enabled platforms, and regulated enterprise environments.
Strong ability to assess monolithic, tightly coupled, database-centric and batch-driven estates and translate findings into practical target-state architecture and migration roadmaps.
Deep understanding of microservices architecture, domain-driven design, service decomposition, database-per-service patterns, distributed workflows, sagas, APIs, and contract-first design.
Strong knowledge of event-driven architecture, Kafka-based event streaming, schema management, asynchronous processing, replayability, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and integration resilience patterns.
Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft .NET ecosystems, REST / gRPC APIs, middleware platforms, enterprise messaging, MSSQL, PostgreSQL, and application modernization technologies.
Strong understanding of cloud-agnostic and hybrid architecture principles including Kubernetes, Docker, containerized deployment, cloud portability, platform engineering, and workload isolation.
Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated quality gates, release orchestration, environment promotion, vulnerability scanning, and audit-ready change management.
Ability to define resilience and operational readiness requirements including high availability, disaster recovery, failover, observability, monitoring, logging, tracing, SLOs, incident handling, and support transition.
Good appreciation of enterprise data platforms like Databricks , governed reporting, data lineage, data quality, auditability, regulatory evidence, and interaction between operational systems and analytical data platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management, architecture governance, decision facilitation, risk articulation, technical communication, and cross-functional coordination skills.
Ability to balance target-state architecture ambition with delivery pragmatism, coexistence constraints, incremental migration, business continuity, operational stability, and regulatory expectations.
Strong documentation discipline across architecture blueprints, transition states, decision records, integration contracts, dependency maps, runbooks, governance artifacts, and executive-level architecture narratives.

Certifications (Preferred):

TOGAF® Enterprise Architecture Practitioner / TOGAF® 9 Certified
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

What You Will Do

Own enterprise architecture assessment and target-state definition for large-scale legacy modernization initiatives across application, integration, data, infrastructure, security, and operations domains.
Assess current-state monolithic applications, shared database dependencies, batch processing models, middleware integrations, reporting dependencies, operational constraints, and resiliency gaps to define pragmatic modernization pathways.
Define future-state architecture aligned to separation of concerns, microservices, database-per-service, API-led integration, event-driven processing, cloud portability, automated delivery, observability, and enterprise governance principles.
Establish architecture guardrails, reference patterns, decision records, integration standards, data ownership principles, service boundary guidance, and non-functional requirements for scalable and resilient modernization delivery.
Guide decomposition of tightly coupled legacy capabilities into domain-aligned services, reusable platform components, controlled interfaces, independently deployable modules, and governed operational workflows.
Support migration strategy using incremental modernization patterns such as strangler migration, parallel run, coexistence, controlled cutover, rollback planning, reconciliation, and phased capability transition.
Provide architecture direction for integration modernization across messaging, APIs, file-based interfaces, event streaming, schema governance, idempotent processing, error handling, retry mechanisms, and dead-letter handling.
Partner with data architecture teams to align application modernization with governed data platforms, lineage, auditability, data quality, reporting readiness, and operational data consumption patterns.
Drive architecture alignment across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid deployment models including Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, secrets management, and environment readiness.
Define and validate resilience, high availability, disaster recovery, failover, monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, operational readiness, and supportability requirements for business-critical enterprise platforms.
Facilitate architecture governance forums, technical design reviews, solution walkthroughs, migration readiness assessments, risk reviews, and cross-team decision-making across delivery workstreams.
Support implementation oversight during build, test, deployment, cutover, stabilization, and hyper-care phases to ensure solutions remain aligned with enterprise architecture guardrails and modernization objectives.
Create and maintain architecture documentation including current-state assessments, target-state blueprints, transition architectures, integration views, dependency maps, decision logs, operational runbooks, and modernization roadmaps.

Why Join Us

At Acuity Analytics, you'll have the opportunity to work across complex enterprise Azure environments while helping shape and improve our Managed Services capability.

You'll solve challenging technical problems, influence standards and automation, mentor other engineers, and work closely with customers and technical teams.

People are at the Heart of our Business. By investing in people, we achieve exceptional results for our clients and create new opportunities for our teams to thrive.

Check out this page for more details.

jobs.title: Software Standards Manager
jobs.description:
Alliance Automotive Group (AAG) is a leading distributor of passenger and commercial vehicle parts to the independent automotive aftermarket in Europe. It operates in France, the U.K., Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Portugal, Poland, Hungary and Romania. The company is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Genuine Parts Company (GPC), the largest global automotive replacement parts distributor with activities in North America, Europe, and Australasia. AAG’s network serves thousands of customers across Europe supported by a logistics infrastructure of 75 Distribution Centres, approximately 2,550 Stores and thousands of vehicle repairers, body shops and auto-centres. AAG has a revenue of 3.4 billion euros with over 17,000 employees. Learn more at www.allianceautomotivegroup.eu

The Software Standards Manager is a new role within Alliance Automotive UK & Ireland, reporting to the Head of Digital & Internal Applications. Operating across both B2B, B2C and internal technology teams, this role exists to bring structure, visibility, and control to a diverse and evolving software landscape shaped by organic and acquisition growth.

With multiple homegrown and proprietary applications primarily built on .NET and LAMP stacks, our engineering teams have historically operated with autonomy in tooling, frameworks, and processes. As we continue to scale, we must now centralise standards around source code management, vulnerability remediation, technical debt allocation, and risk reporting—without disrupting the pace of business value delivery.

The Software Standards Manager acts as the bridge between delivery-focused development teams and compliance, cyber, and risk stakeholders. This role protects engineering capacity by creating a structured intake and prioritisation model for security and compliance requests, ensuring they are logged, translated into backlog items, and progressed in a measurable way.

You will own the catalogue of internally developed applications, maintain visibility of framework lifecycle status, and oversee vulnerability posture across SAST and monitoring tools such as New Relic and Tenable. Through clear weekly reporting and monthly scorecards, you will provide leadership with a single, reliable view of remediation progress and risk exposure.

This is a highly visible and influential role, combining governance, technical literacy and stakeholder management to ensure our software estate is secure and sustainable.

Responsibilities

Technical Role Delivery

Own and maintain a centralised catalogue of all internally developed applications, including framework versions, hosting environments, ownership, and lifecycle status
Drive the centralisation and standardisation of code repository management and software governance practices
Establish and manage a structured intake process for cyber and compliance requirements
Consolidate vulnerability findings from tools such as New Relic, Tenable, and other monitoring platforms
Translate security and compliance findings into clearly defined, prioritised backlog items within Agile workflows
Participate in Agile ceremonies (stands-ups, reviews, retrospectives) to ensure visibility and progress of remediation tasks
Advocate for and track a defined allocation of development capacity toward technical debt and vulnerability remediation
Protect development teams from unstructured or reactive requests by creating a controlled and prioritised engagement model

Performance & Reporting

Act as the primary liaison between Digital, Compliance, and Cyber teams
Design and own structured reporting templates, dashboards, and scorecards
Provide weekly progress updates and monthly governance scorecards to the Head of Department(s) and wider stakeholders
Establish a single source of truth for software risk posture and remediation progress
Clearly communicate risk exposure, remediation velocity, and technical debt reduction trends
Reduce reactive reporting cycles by implementing consistent and predictable governance communications
Support leadership decision-making with accurate, transparent, and actionable insights
Deliver a long-term change program to enable Ping Identity IGA & MFA across all employee-accessed applications

Essential Requirements

Candidate Qualities & Experience

Proven experience working within software engineering environments (Agile/DevOps)
Strong understanding of SDLC, backlog management, and sprint planning processes
Practical experience with vulnerability management and SAST tooling
Ability to interpret technical risk and translate it into prioritised, actionable remediation plans
Demonstrated ability to influence engineering teams without direct line management authority
Experience designing and delivering structured reporting to senior stakeholders.
Working knowledge of modern application stacks (including .NET and/or LAMP environments)
Familiarity with cloud hosting environments and application lifecycle management
Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or related discipline

Highly Desirable Qualities

Experience centralising code repositories and driving engineering standards across multiple teams
Exposure to multi-entity or acquisition-led environments with fragmented technology estates
Experience engaging with Cyber Security and Compliance stakeholders
Experience building governance dashboards or automated reporting metrics
Exposure to SSO and IGA rollout projects (preferably Ping Identity)
Relevant professional certifications, such as:
Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
Agile/Scrum certifications
ITIL (Service Management)

Personal Attributes

Structured and disciplined thinker who brings order to complex environments
Pragmatic and commercially aware, balancing risk reduction with business value delivery
Calm and credible under pressure, able to manage competing stakeholder demand
Confident communicator who can translate technical detail into executive-level clarity
Resilient and assertive when protecting engineering capacity
Naturally collaborative, building trust across Development, Cyber, Compliance, and Leadership teams
Outcome-focused, with a bias toward measurable progress and continuous improvement

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Athlete Performance
jobs.description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re hiring Senior Engineers to join one of our cross-functional product teams in our Athlete Performance group, which is focused on building cutting-edge solutions for athletes and sports teams that directly impact how they train, compete and achieve peak performance. In this role, you’ll build hardware-agnostic ingestion layers and time-series architectures that fuse live video with biomechanical data streams, solving complex real-time data sync and ML inference challenges to give elite coaches and medical teams instant, objective insight into injury prevention and matchday tactics.

As a Senior Engineer, You’ll

Work with a cross-functional team. You’ll collaborate with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Product, Design and Scrum disciplines to deliver full-stack web features.
Develop and deliver. Your team has the autonomy to make a meaningful impact across the entire product area, listen to customers' needs and deliver game-changing features to push the boundaries of what they can achieve. Your team is empowered to take ownership of the user experience to support our coaches and athletes.
Test new ideas. At Hudl, we iterate rapidly, deploying changes to the product hundreds of times daily across our Engineering team. In addition to working on concrete features, you’ll have the opportunity to propose solutions to more ambiguous technical problems and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.
Mentor. You’ll share your expertise and educate others on development best practices and trade-offs, setting an example in planning, designing and delivering complex projects.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team. We're also open to remote candidates in the UK.

Must-Haves

Experienced. You have either led or played a key role in developing large-scale applications.
A team player. You understand that problem-solving is a team effort and will help others on our Engineering team learn and develop their skills.
User-focused. You’re excited to have your work used by real people to solve real problems.
Willing to learn. You have solid engineering skills but are always willing to dive into specific areas to gain the expertise needed to be successful in your role.

Nice-to-Haves

Tech stack knowledge. Our core stack is C#/Node, React, TypeScript, MongoDB/SQL/ElasticSearch and AWS, so experience with these is ideal.

Our Role

Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.
Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.

Inclusion at Hudl

Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.

We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, including employee resource groups and communities. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in annual inclusion reports.

We also know imposter syndrome is real and the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

About The Role

The University of Cambridge's Information Services is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer. You will join a multidisciplinary development team within a Division of 50 engineers building high-profile bespoke web systems and cloud-native services, and modernising existing applications.

This is a hybrid position, with amazing benefits, like a defined benefit pension and 41 days of annual leave inclusive of public holidays.

Our services are public-facing and support University staff and students (~60,000 people), meaning your work will have a significant impact on the reputation of one of the world's leading universities. We develop new services using modern web architectural standards with an emphasis on reusability, APIs, test automation, and CI. Services are deployed to cloud infrastructure in Docker containers.

Our technology stack is published in our Guidebook and comprises technologies like Google Cloud, Terraform, Docker, Python, Django, React, and TypeScript. We maintain a DevOps culture and use Scrum for our day-to-day work. We have also adopted an "open by default" approach to new work and thus you can find much of our work to date in our GitLab. The team also produces a Guidebook that collects the team's practices and useful information at https://guidebook.devops.uis.cam.ac.uk/

What we're looking for

You will be highly skilled in modern software development, testing, security, and operations, and be an expert in:

Architecting secure-by-design web applications and APIs with a focus on maintainability and stability, using clean code.

Integrating applications via APIs, event buses, and asynchronous tasks.

Writing expert-level Python and Django, with working knowledge of TypeScript and React (or comparable languages and frameworks).

Packaging web applications in Docker containers.

Writing and applying efficient tests with good knowledge of testing frameworks and testing best practices.

Conducting thorough code reviews.

Using AI coding assistants effectively, writing clear prompts, critically reviewing AI-generated code, and taking responsibility for its correctness, security, and maintainability.

Building CI/CD pipelines in GitLab to test and deploy web applications to the cloud using Terraform.

Working with Google Cloud or similar cloud platforms.

Managing software requirements, priorities, and dependencies.

Driving improvements in technical architecture, standards, and processes, and choosing the right solution for the problem (switching off, extending, building, or buying).

Debug effectively in unfamiliar applications.

Ways Of Working

Work in cross-functional teams using a DevOps approach, mentoring more junior engineers.

Communicate clearly in both written and verbal forms, and collaborate with University colleagues, users, and business representatives to gather and refine detailed requirements.

Focus on delivery while taking a continuous-improvement approach to existing services.

Learn new skills proactively and stay current with modern practices.

Apply AI tools pragmatically as they evolve, without compromising the quality, security, or ownership of the code you ship.

Work across products and teams to build consistent architectures, thinking through their impact on other services and the wider organisation.

Understand specifications and produce simple architectures from complex problems.

Drive work to completion, adjusting pace to the urgency of the task.

Fixed-term: The funds for this post are available for 2 years in the first instance.

Applications are welcome from internal candidates who would like to apply for the role on the basis of a secondment from their current role in the University.

We welcome applications from individuals who wish to be considered for part-time working or other flexible working arrangements.

We particularly welcome applications from women and /or candidates from a BME background for this vacancy as they are currently under-represented at this level in our department.

DEP provides the central leadership and development for the British Council’s Data Analytics and Evidence Strategy working across the organisation with stakeholders to leverage our Data and Evidence assets. Relationship and Stakeholder Management

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

Today, EF English Live does not consistently apply appropriate QA coverage to relevant Salesforce and Web tickets before release. Volume has outpaced our current QA capacity, so coverage gaps happen, and where testing does happen it often leans towards happy-path checks rather than risk-based regression testing. We already use AIO for automation and want to build on it further, and more hands are needed to close the coverage gap in the meantime.

This role is about adding real capacity: hands-on testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, with risk-based coverage applied according to the nature and impact of each change, plus active support extending and complementing our existing AIO automation. Our existing QA lead will continue to own and drive the automation strategy; this hire works alongside them, splitting time between hands-on testing and helping extend that automation over time.

Role Overview

This is a fixed-term contract engagement, initially for 4 to 6 months. The Senior QA Automation Engineer will provide thorough, hands-on testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, applying risk-based coverage according to the nature and impact of each change, while also helping extend and complement our existing AIO automation. This is a genuinely hybrid role: meaningful hands-on testing capacity now, and a growing share of automation work over time , done in close partnership with our existing QA lead rather than in place of them.

Within 3 Months, Success Looks Like

All relevant Salesforce and Web tickets receiving appropriate QA coverage before release, with risk-based testing applied according to the nature and impact of the change.
Regression testing meaningfully expanded beyond happy-path checks.
Our existing AIO automation extended and complemented, with additional tooling or approaches identified where they would provide better coverage or maintainability.
The existing QA lead measurably better supported, with more capacity across the team rather than the load resting on one person.

Main Responsibilities

Hands-On QA Coverage (Salesforce & Web)

Provide thorough manual and exploratory testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, applying risk-based testing according to the nature and impact of each change.
Prioritise regression testing, not just happy-path checks, to reduce the risk of shipping undetected issues.

Test Automation & Tooling

Extend and complement our existing AIO automation, identifying where additional tooling or approaches would provide better coverage or maintainability.
Work alongside the existing QA lead, who owns the overall automation strategy and roadmap, contributing hands-on automation build where needed.

Collaboration & Capability Building

Work alongside the existing QA lead and engineering team to raise the overall QA bar, across both tooling and process.
Partner with Business Systems and engineering leads to prioritise coverage based on commercial risk.

Reporting

Report to Business Systems Engineering leadership, with visibility on release risk and quality metrics shared with the wider team.

Technical Background & Skills

Core Experience

Strong hands-on manual and exploratory testing experience across web applications and, ideally, CRM/Salesforce environments.
Experience in automating tests using Javascript /Typescript frameworks (e.g. Nightwatch.js, Cypress, Playwright)
Experience with API and integration testing, including validating data flows between Salesforce, web applications and third-party systems.

About VantagePoint

VantagePoint is a global finance transformation and technology consultancy helping organisations modernise the finance function through process improvement, data and leading technology platforms.
Founded in London, we've grown rapidly from a team of five to more than 100 professionals across Europe, North America and APAC.
We specialise in implementing and optimising market-leading finance technologies, supporting organisations through complex transformation programmes and helping finance teams operate with greater control, transparency and insight.
Our model combines deep finance expertise with strong technical delivery - enabling us to deliver practical outcomes and build long-term partnerships with our clients.

The opportunity

We're looking for a Data & AI Solutions Architect to own and evolve VantagePoint's internal data, systems and automation architecture as we continue to scale.
Our ambition is to build a best-in-class internal data and technology ecosystem - connected, scalable and increasingly AI-enabled. As a finance transformation and technology consultancy, we want the way we operate internally to reflect the same standards and ambition we bring to our clients.
This is a hands-on role. You'll set the direction and architecture, but you'll also build, configure, integrate and improve the solutions behind it. You'll inherit an active roadmap, deliver immediate improvements and help shape what our future technology and data landscape should look like.
The challenge isn't simply technical. You'll work across the business to understand requirements, prioritise competing needs, make recommendations and lead change through to adoption.
We need someone equally comfortable stepping back to design the right solution and getting stuck in to make it work.

Our tech stack

You'll be working across a broad and evolving technology landscape, including:
Microsoft 365 | NetSuite | Sage | CCH Tagetik | Attio | n8n | Zapier | SQL | Power BI | Rippling | Cledara | Notion | Rocketlane | Claude

You don't need to have worked with every platform. We're more interested in your ability to understand how systems, data and workflows fit together, learn new technologies quickly and design better ways of connecting them.

What you'll own

Data & systems architecture

Own the architecture across our core internal systems, data and integrations.
Design clean, scalable data models and flows across commercial, delivery, finance and operational platforms.
Set clear standards for data quality, governance, integrations and development.
Identify architectural weaknesses, duplication and manual processes and design pragmatic solutions.
Balance immediate business needs with long-term scalability.

Automation & AI

Identify where automation and AI can materially improve how the business operates.
Design and build automated workflows across systems and teams.
Explore and implement practical AI-enabled solutions, agents and new ways of using AI to configure and improve our systems and workflows.
Reduce manual processing, re-keying and unnecessary administration.
Help us scale the use of AI and automation across the organisation.
Measure impact through time saved, better data, reduced errors and improved decision-making.

Build & execution

Pick up our existing systems and data roadmap and move quickly into delivery.
Build and configure solutions directly, working with external developers or suppliers where needed.
Prototype ideas, test approaches and deliver quick wins alongside longer-term architecture.
Diagnose and resolve issues across systems, integrations and data flows.
Maintain appropriate technical documentation and development standards.

Roadmap & change

Own and maintain a prioritised roadmap across data, systems, automation and AI.
Gather requirements and translate business needs into clear technical plans and solutions.
Manage multiple initiatives from concept through implementation and adoption.
Communicate progress, dependencies, decisions and risks clearly.
Ensure changes work for the people using them - not just technically.

Business partnership

Build a strong understanding of how VantagePoint operates across sales, delivery, finance and operations.
Translate business problems into practical technology and data solutions.
Present recommendations and options clearly to senior stakeholders.
Bring structure to ambiguous problems and help prioritise where technology investment will create the greatest value.
Act as a trusted internal advisor while remaining close enough to the detail to deliver.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who understands the technology, sees the bigger business picture and knows how to turn both into practical solutions.

You’ll bring a strong combination of:

Data architecture, data engineering, systems architecture or software engineering experience.
Designing data models, integrations and end-to-end data flows.
Strong hands-on SQL capability and experience with relational databases.
Python or another development language used to solve real business problems.
APIs, integrations and cloud-based architectures.
Workflow automation and low-code/no-code tooling.
BI and analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau or similar.
Cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
Practical application of AI, LLMs, agents or AI-enabled automation.
Experience working across CRM, ERP, finance, project or operational systems - experience with some of our current technology stack would be beneficial, but isn't essential.

Just as importantly, you'll be someone who:

Can think strategically without disappearing into strategy.
Enjoys being hands-on and building solutions, not just designing them.
Can take an ambiguous problem and turn it into a structured plan.
Prioritises effectively and keeps delivery moving.
Communicates confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Can challenge senior stakeholders constructively and explain your reasoning.
Understands that successful technology change is as much about people and adoption as architecture.
Takes ownership and follows things through.
Enjoys working in a fast-moving environment where not everything has already been defined.

What success looks like

Within your first 6-12 months:
We have a clear, prioritised data, systems, automation and AI roadmap.
Our core systems have cleaner, more scalable integrations and data flows.
High-value manual processes have been removed or automated.
AI and automation are embedded into how we operate, delivering measurable improvements to our systems and workflows.
Technical decisions and architecture are better documented and governed.
Teams understand what's changing, why and when.
Leadership has confidence that our internal technology landscape can support the next stage of VantagePoint's growth.

Why VantagePoint?

This is an opportunity to take real ownership of how technology, data and AI support a growing global business.
You'll join with an active roadmap and plenty to get stuck into from day one, but with genuine scope to shape what comes next. You'll work directly with senior leadership, challenge and improve how we operate, and see the impact of what you build across the business.
For someone who enjoys solving complex problems and building rather than simply maintaining, there's significant scope to make this role your own.

Benefits

Alongside a competitive salary and performance bonus, we offer:
Up to 10% matched pension contribution
Private healthcare
Life cover
Hybrid working
Free travel to the London office
Gym or wellbeing allowance
EAP – Employee Assistance Programme
Monthly phone allowance
Paid company socials
Cycle to Work scheme

Our values

Thrive together
- we win as one team

Take ownership
- accountability for outcomes, not just tasks

Quality, every time
- consistent, well-judged delivery

Be human, first
- trust, empathy and respect

Speak with clarity
- open, direct, low ego

Move with intent
- decisive, reflective, always improving

Our recruitment process

jobs.description:
Head of Engineering – Financial Services | £150,000 + Bonus + Benefits | Paddington, London – 4 Days Office

A leading organisation within the financial services sector
is undergoing a major technology transformation, modernising its core trading, data, and analytics platforms. With significant investment into its technology function, the business is building a next-generation platform to support data-driven decision making and improve the way its trading teams operate.

As part of this transformation, the organisation is seeking a Head of Engineering
to lead a growing technology function across software development, data engineering and QA
. This is a senior engineering leadership position with responsibility for technical direction, engineering standards, delivery and team development.

The Opportunity

This is a key leadership role for an experienced engineering leader who enjoys working in a hands-on, technically complex environment. You will lead the engineering function while remaining close to the technology, working with developers, data engineers and QA engineers to deliver high-quality platforms supporting the firm's financial services and trading activities.
You will take ownership of engineering strategy and delivery, helping shape the architecture, development practices and technology roadmap. You will work closely with senior stakeholders across technology and the business to ensure the engineering function continues to support the firm's trading and commercial objectives.

The platform will process and integrate large volumes of data, supporting teams across trading, risk, analytics and operations
. You will have the opportunity to shape a modern engineering function and play a key role in the ongoing transformation of the firm's technology estate.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and develop the engineering function across Software Development, Data Engineering and QA
.
• Own the engineering strategy, technical direction and delivery of critical technology across the firm's financial services and trading platforms.
• Build and maintain a high-performing engineering team, supporting recruitment, development, mentoring and progression.
• Provide technical leadership across architecture, software development, data platforms, testing and system integration.
• Work closely with senior technology and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
• Oversee the development of applications, APIs, microservices and data platforms supporting financial services and trading.
• Establish and maintain strong engineering standards around code quality, testing, deployment and documentation.
• Drive the adoption of modern development practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, cloud technologies and DevOps.
• Ensure close collaboration between developers, data engineers and QA throughout the development lifecycle.
• Help shape the long-term architecture and technology roadmap as the organisation continues its modernisation programme.
• Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, creating a strong culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience leading an engineering function or large engineering team within a complex technology environment.
• Strong background in software engineering, ideally with experience across development, data engineering and QA
.
• Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, microservices and data platforms.
• Experience with C#/.NET would be highly advantageous.
• Strong understanding of cloud technologies, DevOps, CI/CD and automated testing.
• Experience building and developing high-performing engineering teams.
• Comfortable operating at both a strategic and technical level, with the ability to engage with engineers as well as senior business stakeholders.
• Experience working with complex data environments or high-volume, real-time systems.
• Financial services, capital markets, trading or commodities experience would be highly advantageous.

• A strong communicator who can provide clear technical direction while giving engineering teams the autonomy to deliver.

Compensation
: Up to £150,000 + Bonus + Benefits
Location
: Paddington, London
Working Pattern
: 4 days per week in the office

, send your CV to Joe@virtuetech.io or reply.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Our corporate activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a Junior Software Engineer to join our Information Technology team. The Junior Software Engineer position will work on a team focused on our core clinical systems as well as internal applications. Strong attention to detail, innovation, and implementation of new technologies are highly valued.

To meet our global and innovation demands, Medpace is rapidly growing our software development footprint beyond the US. To support our growth, we are expanding our existing office in Warsaw to build our first non-US development center. This is an incredible opportunity to join, contribute, and shape a new team, while also being a part of a large, fast-growing organization. Our custom software is a key component to our success. You will be joining an organization where your contribution makes a significant impact in positively impacting people's lives, as new treatments and therapeutics are developed.

We kindly ask that you submit applications in English.

Responsibilities

Collect, analyze and document user requirements;
Design, modify, develop and support software applications;
Participate in software validation process through development, review, and/or execution of test plan/cases/scripts;
Create software applications by following software development life-cycle, which includes requirements gathering, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance;
Communicate with team members regarding projects, development, tools, and procedures;
Utilize skills in development areas including object oriented programming (C#), databases (SQL) web applications (ASP.NET);
Potential opportunities to lead software development projects.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science;
1-2 years of software development experience using technologies such as C#, Angular, Webservices, GraphQL, Git, relational databases;
Experience in Entity Framework, Azure DevOps is advantageous;
Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and software release management;
Prior experience modernizing systems to a cloud-based platform (Azure) is a plus;
Excellent analytical, written and oral communication skills in English.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer specializing in .NET and frontend frameworks such as Angular/React, you will design and develop new features and enhancements across the full technology stack, with a strong emphasis on usability, performance, scalability, and security. 

You will own complex components end-to-end, contribute meaningfully to architecture and design discussions, and help translate business requirements into reliable, cloud-native solutions running in AWS. Your work will influence technical direction at the service and component level within a globally used flagship product. 

Responsibilities: 

Design and develop web applications based on microservice architecture, utilizing Angular/React and .NET technologies, with a focus on ease of use, performance, scalability, and security. 
Own complex components end-to-end, from requirements refinement and technical design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 
Contribute to architecture, framework, database, and service design decisions, proposing improvements aligned with project goals, constraints, and platform standards. 
Build and maintain automated tests, quality gates, CI/CD pipelines, and code review practices to ensure secure, maintainable, high-quality delivery. 
Contribute to containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, while supporting production operations through monitoring, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and preventive improvements. 
Collaborate with Product Owners, stakeholders, developers, IT, ML engineers, data analysts, and researchers in Agile Scrum ceremonies, while mentoring mid-level engineers and sharing best practices. 

What We’re Looking For: 

Key qualifications: 

Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
5–7+ years of software development experience, including delivery of web-based applications and cloud-native systems. 
Fullstack development experience with strong backend expertise in C# .NET Core, REST APIs, and familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as Angular or React. 
Experience with microservices architecture, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Git workflows, automated testing, SQL databases, schema design, performant queries, and ORMs such as Entity Framework. 

Key soft skills: 

Strong collaboration skills and comfort working across development, IT, product, data, research, and engineering teams. 
Proactive, curious, and action-oriented approach to solving technical and business problems. 
Commitment to engineering excellence, security, maintainability, documentation, pair programming, and continuous improvement. 
Good spoken and written English, B2 level or above. 

Required Knowledge / Technologies: 

Proficiency in C#, .NET Core, .NET Framework, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, RESTful services, and software engineering best practices. 
Practical experience with Angular/React and foundational knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for frontend integration. 
Docker, containerization, Kubernetes, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and cloud-native application design. 
Azure DevOps for planning, repositories, pipelines, and releases; Git-based version control and collaborative workflows including pull requests and code reviews. 
SQL databases, schema design, performant query writing, ORMs such as Entity Framework, automated testing, CI/CD, and quality gates. 

What’s in it for you: 

Engaging projects focused on building robust, scalable, secure cloud-based solutions in AWS. 
Close collaboration with experienced software developers, ML engineers, data analysts, and researchers. 
Opportunity to influence technical direction at the service and component level within a flagship product used globally. 
Corporate support for personal growth and career development, provision of all necessary equipment, and benefits including medical package, Multisport, life insurance, and the internal Wellbeing program.

Programista C#/.NET (WPF, Windows Forms, VB.NET)

C#
.NET 8
VB.NET

WPF (Code-behind, Custom Controls)
Windows Forms

Entity Framework
SQLite
Microsoft SQL Server

Programowanie asynchroniczne w .NET
Git

Tworzenie i rozwój aplikacji desktopowych w środowisku .NET (WPF oraz Windows Forms).

Rozwój, utrzymanie i modyfikacja istniejącego kodu w VB.NET.

Współpraca z zespołem przy analizie wymagań oraz rozwiązywaniu problemów technicznych.

Praktyczna znajomość języków C# oraz VB.NET.
Doświadczenie w pracy z technologiami WPF oraz Windows Forms.

Umiejętność stosowania programowania asynchronicznego w środowisku .NET.

Znajomość systemu kontroli wersji Git będzie dodatkowym atutem.

Umiejętności pracy zespołowej.
Samodzielności, dokładności, odpowiedzialności oraz terminowości.

Dociekliwości i skuteczności w rozwiązywaniu problemów.

Zaangażowania i motywacji do pracy.
Umiejętności pozytywnej komunikacji.
Wykazywania inicjatywy oraz chęci rozwoju.
Otwartości na zdobywanie nowej wiedzy i doświadczeń.

Zatrudnienie na pełny etat w dynamicznie rozwijającej się firmie.
Pracę w niewielkim, zaangażowanym i stabilnym zespole.
Przyjazną atmosferę pracy.

Możliwość pracy przy rozwiązaniach mających realne zastosowanie w systemach wykorzystywanych przez służby ratunkowe.
