jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.

You will join Relativity’s Data Transfer group, a high-impact engineering team within the Ingestion Department. The team builds and scales infrastructure that powers secure, reliable, and high-throughput data movement across the RelativityOne SaaS platform.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary mission will be to design, write, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products. You will work within a Scrum team, collaborating with Advanced, Senior, Lead, and Staff engineers as well as business stakeholders to develop products, features, and services that evolve the RelativityOne SaaS offering.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Contribute to a Scrum team across all phases of the service lifecycle, including conception, design, development, testing, deployment, and operations
Design and architect performant, scalable, and secure software with a strong focus on quality beyond basic requirements
Apply object-oriented analysis, design, and programming principles, including SOLID principles and established design patterns
Provide technical guidance to the development team to deliver high-quality, secure, and scalable software operating on large datasets
Participate in code reviews to ensure quality and maintainability
Develop and execute unit, integration, and static testing strategies
Apply practical knowledge of AI-assisted SDLC frameworks and best practices
Improve software development processes by recommending and driving changes
Identify and automate repetitive processes and tasks
Contribute to and enhance automated CI/CD deployment and upgrade workflows
Use monitoring and observability tools to proactively identify and resolve issues
Improve software quality and completeness while sharing knowledge across the team
Troubleshoot issues, fix defects, and respond to client-specific problems
Provide guidance and coaching to team members through knowledge sharing
Participate in on-call support rotations (second-line support) after gaining relevant experience
Support a learning culture and promote a healthy, collaborative work environment

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
At least five years of experience developing commercial-grade software using C# or related object-oriented languages such as Java or C++
Strong experience with SaaS systems, including multi-tenant architecture, subscription lifecycle, and operational support
Deep understanding of observability and telemetry, including distributed tracing, metrics, logging, alerting, and incident response
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including unit testing, code reviews, design documentation, and debugging
Experience with cloud DevOps practices and CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Harness, LaunchDarkly)
Experience working in agile teams, including mentoring, feature leadership, and cross-team collaboration
Experience with observability tools such as New Relic or Splunk
Fluency in English

Preferred

Experience working with large-scale, distributed systems and data-intensive platforms
Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and frameworks
Experience improving engineering processes and automation in cloud-native environments

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.

With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

About Atos Group

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.

About The Role

We are looking for a talented Senior Azure Cloud-Native Application Developer
to join our team and contribute to exciting, high-profile projects for one of our strategic clients. In this role, you will help design, develop, and modernize cloud-native applications on the Microsoft Azure platform, delivering scalable, secure, and innovative solutions that drive real business value.

Develop cloud-native applications using Azure App Services, Functions, and Logic Apps.
Modernize, refactor, and re-platform legacy applications to Azure cloud environments.
Participate in cloud transformation and application modernization initiatives.
Collaborate with architects, DevOps engineers, and development teams to ensure reliable and scalable solutions.
Build APIs and integrate third-party services using Azure API Management.
Write clean, maintainable, secure, and scalable code following established development standards.
Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve issues related to cloud applications and services.

 Required Skill

Hands-on experience developing applications on the Microsoft Azure platform.
Experience with Azure App Services, Azure Functions, and Azure Logic Apps.
Proficiency in C#, .NET, ASP .NET, MS SQL, Azure DevOps.
Knowledge of Azure API Management and application integration patterns.
Familiarity with DevOps practices and agile methodologies to drive efficient collaboration and speed to delivery.
Azure Developer certification is a plus, but hands-on experience is equally valued.

What We Offer

Hybrid work you can truly shape – friendly model designed for real work‑life balance (max. 2 office days per month, or less - depending on location)
Choose the cooperation model that fits you – Employment Contract or B2B
Fair compensation – salary matched to your experience + annual bonus + copyrights
Feel good at work – passion‑sharing meetups, team moments and initiatives

Job Title:

Senior SQA Engineer – Test Automation / Manual Testing

About us:

Accuris launched in May 2023 as a standalone company and was formerly known as S&P Global’s Engineering Solutions division. Accuris has been an integral part of the engineering ecosystem for more than 60 years and is valued for standards content and workflow solutions including Engineering Workbench, Goldfire, Haystack, and Parts Management Solutions.

The Team:

The Engineering Workbench team builds and evolves a flagship Accuris product used globally by engineering professionals. You will collaborate closely with software developers, QA specialists, Product Owners, IT partners, and engineering stakeholders. The team values ownership, practical test automation, clear communication, continuous improvement, and proactive collaboration across disciplines.

The Impact:

As a Senior SQA Engineer, you will design software testing plans, create and execute manual and automated tests, and help ensure the quality of web applications and services throughout the full product lifecycle, including Production.

You will guide the team on when and how to automate effectively, influence testability during design and development phases, coordinate defect management, and provide clear test results, regression feedback, and quality insights to development teams.

Responsibilities:

Design software testing plans and create and execute both manual and automated tests using test automation tools including, but not limited to Selenium and Playwright.

Monitor Production quality and coordinate resolution of issues assigned to teams.
Ensure compliance of team testing activities with project rules, quality standards, and agreed processes.
Participate in functional testing during CI/CD processes and support reliable product releases.
Organize and monitor defect management processes within teams.
Influence the inclusion of testability during design, grooming, and development phases.
Test the product in all phases of its lifecycle, including Production.
Interface with developers in the project by providing clear test results and identifying regression areas.

What We’re Looking For:

Key qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4+ years of automation engineering experience with Selenium WebDriver and/or Playwright using C#/.NET and xUnit frameworks.
Experience testing web applications built with .NET Core, microservices, and AngularJS, including cross-browser and cross-device validation using automated tools.
Solid knowledge of databases, including the ability to write CRUD operations, work with JOINs, and validate data-driven application behavior.

Key soft skills:

Strong collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate testing activities, defect management, and issue resolution across development teams.
Clear, structured communication with developers, including the ability to provide test results, regression areas, and actionable defect information.
Proactive approach to quality, testability, production monitoring, and continuous improvement throughout the software development lifecycle.
Good spoken and written English.

Required Knowledge / Technologies:

Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, C#/.NET, xUnit frameworks, manual testing, automated testing, functional testing, and test case/script design and execution.
Testing of web applications in .NET Core, microservices, AngularJS, client-server application architecture, RESTful APIs, and CI/CD processes.
Databases and SQL, including CRUD operations, JOINs, data validation, and practical understanding of application data flows.
Docker containerization basics, AWS cloud services such as EC2, S3, RDS, or similar, and development tools such as Visual Studio, VS Code, or Rider.
Agile software development, Azure DevOps / ADOPS bug tracking, defect management, and exposure to performance and load testing tools such as CloudTest, Cloud Testing using ADOPS, or K6 are considered a plus.

What’s in it for you:

Opportunity to shape testing strategy and improve automation practices for a flagship product used globally.
Hands-on work across manual testing, automation, API testing, CI/CD validation, production quality monitoring, and defect management.
Close collaboration with experienced developers, Product Owners, IT partners, and engineering stakeholders in an Agile environment.
Corporate support for personal growth and career development, provision of all necessary equipment, and benefits including medical package, Multisport, life insurance, and the internal Wellbeing program.

The Location:

Poland.

Budget:

PLN 20,000–24,000 gross per month, with flexibility depending on seniority and experience, plus 5% bonus.

Compensation/Benefits Information

Accuris states that the anticipated base salary / budget for this position is PLN 20,000–24,000 gross per month, with flexibility depending on seniority and experience. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographical location as well as experience and qualifications for the role. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for a 5% bonus as well as comprehensive benefits. For more information on benefits, please reach out to the recruiter assigned to the role.

Benefits include a medical package, Multisport, life insurance, internal Wellbeing program, corporate support for personal growth and career development, and provision of all necessary equipment.

Accuris delivers essential intelligence that powers decision making. We provide the world’s leading organizations with the right data, connected technologies, and expertise they need to move ahead. jobs.title: Senior Java Developer
jobs.description:
About ITRex

THE PLACE

ITRex - AI pioneers who build systems that actually work in the real world, not just in demos. We're 250+ people spread across the US and Europe, creating solutions for companies like Procter & Gamble and Shutterstock. We keep it simple, build it right, and focus on what works.

THE PEOPLE

We're the kind of people who don't ignore messages in Slack, who jump in to help when you're stuck on a problem, and who offer solutions instead of blame when things go sideways. We believe in openness, accountability, and having each other's backs. No office politics, no hidden agendas - just people who care about doing good work together and supporting each other to get there.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a senior Java engineer to join a team in the middle of a serious AI transformation, building a Spring Boot microservices backend on Kubernetes and bringing AI into the whole development process - so we need someone who already works this way, can judge when an AI suggestion helps versus quietly introduces a bug, and wants to help shape that practice for the team, working daily in pair programming and a cross-functional group alongside product, QA and DevOps. The engagement runs to the end of the year, with a high probability of extension

Your Responsibilities

Design, build and own Spring Boot microservices and the Web APIs around them, from the data model through to what runs in Kubernetes
Take end-to-end responsibility for the features you ship: schema, service, API contract, tests, pipeline and the behaviour in production
Use AI assistance deliberately across the development cycle - design exploration, implementation, refactoring, tests, review - and stay accountable for everything that gets merged
Help establish the team's AI-assisted engineering practice: what works, what to avoid, where a human review gate belongs, and how new joiners get up to speed with it
Pair with other engineers on hard problems and share context instead of hoarding it
Contribute to architectural decisions on service boundaries, communication patterns and data ownership, and argue your position clearly when you disagree
Keep the build pipeline healthy: GitLab and Jenkins stages, test suites, container builds and Terraform-managed infrastructure
Review other people's code with the same care you want applied to your own
Work directly with product, QA and DevOps to turn ambiguous requirements into something shippable, rather than waiting for a fully specified ticket
As a lead, set technical direction on your part of the system and mentor the engineers around you

Requirements

Our Expectations

Core Java: Java 11 and Java 17, the concurrency model, collections, memory behaviour and the language features that actually changed how modern services are written
Solid, production-grade experience with the Spring Framework and Spring Boot: dependency injection, configuration, Spring Data, Spring Security, REST controllers and the testing support
Web API development: designing, versioning, documenting and evolving HTTP APIs that other teams depend on
Microservice architecture: service decomposition, inter-service communication, resilience patterns, data ownership, and an honest sense of when a microservice is the wrong answer
SQL and relational data modelling with PostgreSQL and MySQL - schema design, indexing, query tuning and migrations
Automated testing as a habit: JUnit, Mockito, integration tests and the judgement to know what deserves coverage
Maven for build and dependency management
Docker, and Kubernetes at the level of someone who deploys onto it and debugs on it - how workloads, services, config, secrets and resource limits fit together. Running the cluster itself is not your job
Terraform and infrastructure as code
CI/CD with GitLab and Jenkins: pipelines you can read, extend and fix
Practical experience with AI-assisted software development, and genuine interest in driving that practice forward inside the team
Willingness to work in pair programming
Strong communication skills and a track record in cross-functional teams; you enjoy solving problems together rather than working through tickets alone
English at B2 level or above

Nice to have

Observability in practice: Grafana dashboards, Kibana and the ELK stack, Sentry for error tracking
Structured logging and alerting design - deciding what a service should say about itself and when someone should be woken up
Performance testing and profiling of JVM services under load
Experience introducing AI-assisted workflows to a team: prompt and context practices, review discipline, guardrails for generated code
Prior work in a lead or tech-lead capacity on a distributed backend

Benefits

What We Offer

Why people stay

First, the foundation:

Remote flexibility: Work where and how you work best - we trust you to deliver
Fair compensation: Competitive salary + benefits that matter (medical, wellness, learning)

Then, the growth:

Ownership opportunities: See a problem worth solving? Own it. We back smart risks over bureaucratic safety
AI enhancement: We leverage AI to make you faster and stronger - complementing your abilities, not replacing them
Learning investment: English classes, professional development, well-being support
Career progression: Real paths up, not just sideways shuffling

Finally, the people:

Responsive teammates: No ignored Slacks, no "not my problem" attitudes
Supportive culture: When you're stuck, people help. When things break, we fix them together
Human connections: Regular meetups, tech talks, and actual relationships beyond work

your ideas could ignite global innovation?

.

We have an opportunity for a highly motivated and technically curious Associate Sales Engineer, fluent in German/French/Italian/Spanish/Dutch, to join our dynamic Enterprise Sales Engineering team in Warsaw, reporting to the Manager of Sales Engineering for the region. In this role, you will work closely with experienced sales engineers and account executives to support the sales process and help customers understand the value of Infoblox solutions. You will also learn all aspects of the sales process and participate in Infoblox global technical training programs.

Assist in delivering technical presentations and product demonstrations to prospective customers
Support the development of proof-of-concepts / values (POC/Vs) of Infoblox solutions
Collaborate with pre-sales solutions architects to gather customer requirements and map them to Infoblox’s offerings
Leverage defined pre-sales tools in customer engagements and supporting pre-sales solutions architects

Learn and maintain a solid understanding of our DDI, DNS security, and cloud networking solutions
Leverage AI-enabled tools and platforms (including internal Copilot-style solutions) to accelerate technical discovery, tailor demos and POCs, analyze customer environments, and clearly articulate the value of Infoblox’s AI-driven networking and security capabilities
Participate in discovery calls and meetings to understand customer environments and challenges
Contribute to the creation of technical documentation, solution diagrams, and sales collateral
Enable partner technical sales teams on Infoblox solutions and positioning to customers

Be Prepared — What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field
3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role for a technology organization
Interest in networking, cybersecurity, or cloud technologies
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Practical AI fluency, with the ability to confidently use AI-assisted tools for technical analysis, demo preparation, solution design, and customer conversations, understanding both the capabilities and limitations of AI in enterprise networking and security contexts
Ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
Eagerness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment
Basic understanding of networking concepts such as DNS, DHCP, and IP addressing
Fluency in English with German
Ideally some familiarity with Infoblox products or similar technologies or experience with networking labs, cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, or scripting, such as Python or Bash

Be Successful — Your Path

First 90 Days:
Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors, and map the systems and stakeholders that rely on your work
Six Months:

Have a foundational knowledge of our product/solution portfolio
Demonstrate fluency with either on-prem or SaaS-based Infoblox solutions
Identify 1-2 specialisation areas
Capable of handling primary SE customer-facing tasks with help from others

One Year:

Demonstrate fluency with all Infoblox solutions
Capable of handling advanced SE customer-facing tasks with only occasional help from others
Go-to person for specialisation area for the assigned region

Belong —
Your Community

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.
Be Rewarded —
Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong

Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.

You will join Relativity’s Data Transfer group, a high-impact engineering team within the Ingestion Department. The team builds and scales infrastructure that powers secure, reliable, and high-throughput data movement across the RelativityOne SaaS platform.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary mission will be to design, write, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products. You will work within a Scrum team, collaborating with Advanced, Senior, Lead, and Staff engineers as well as business stakeholders to develop products, features, and services that evolve the RelativityOne SaaS offering.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Contribute to a Scrum team across all phases of the service lifecycle, including conception, design, development, testing, deployment, and operations
Design and architect performant, scalable, and secure software with a strong focus on quality beyond basic requirements
Apply object-oriented analysis, design, and programming principles, including SOLID principles and established design patterns
Provide technical guidance to the development team to deliver high-quality, secure, and scalable software operating on large datasets
Participate in code reviews to ensure quality and maintainability
Develop and execute unit, integration, and static testing strategies
Apply practical knowledge of AI-assisted SDLC frameworks and best practices
Improve software development processes by recommending and driving changes
Identify and automate repetitive processes and tasks
Contribute to and enhance automated CI/CD deployment and upgrade workflows
Use monitoring and observability tools to proactively identify and resolve issues
Improve software quality and completeness while sharing knowledge across the team
Troubleshoot issues, fix defects, and respond to client-specific problems
Provide guidance and coaching to team members through knowledge sharing
Participate in on-call support rotations (second-line support) after gaining relevant experience
Support a learning culture and promote a healthy, collaborative work environment

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
At least five years of experience developing commercial-grade software using C# or related object-oriented languages such as Java or C++
Strong experience with SaaS systems, including multi-tenant architecture, subscription lifecycle, and operational support
Deep understanding of observability and telemetry, including distributed tracing, metrics, logging, alerting, and incident response
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including unit testing, code reviews, design documentation, and debugging
Experience with cloud DevOps practices and CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Harness, LaunchDarkly)
Experience working in agile teams, including mentoring, feature leadership, and cross-team collaboration
Experience with observability tools such as New Relic or Splunk
Fluency in English

Preferred

Experience working with large-scale, distributed systems and data-intensive platforms
Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and frameworks
Experience improving engineering processes and automation in cloud-native environments

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

jobs.title: Backendutvecklare .NET/Azure till prisbelönt digitalbyrå
jobs.description:
Att vakna på morgonen med längtan att gå till jobbet!

Vi har ett mål att alla som jobbar hos oss ska trivas så mycket att man vaknar med ett leende på måndag morgon. Vi är kanske inte Sveriges bästa bolag inom alla punkter men vi är Sveriges näst bästa bolag enligt Great Place to Work 2020. Vi tror att det beror på vår energi och nyfikenhet, vårt sätt att välkomna olikheter och våra erfarenheter som vi gärna delar med oss av.

Rebel and Bird är ett av B3s dotterbolag som tar hand om kunders önskemål och krav och förädlar dessa till flerfaldigt prisbelönta tekniska lösningar. Du blir inte nedbunden i gamla tekniker utan får möjligheten att jobba med det senaste inom backend och utvecklas med oss varje dag. Vårt absolut tydligaste mål med verksamheten är att alla ska ha kul på jobbet. Det låter som en plattityd men det är vårt stora mål. Vi försöker (när så går) att träffas och göra roliga saker utanför arbetstid någon gång i månaden utöver julfest, sommarfest och konferenser.

Arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer arbeta både i interna och externa åtaganden, dvs i våra egna produktutvecklingsteam där vi tar helhetsgrepp på våra kunders önskemål, från koncept till UX och publicerad webb samt ibland på konsultbasis i våra kunders team. Vi har i dagsläget tre större åtaganden men en hel del mindre inhouse-projekt och externa konsultåtaganden. Här är två större inhouse-åtaganden:

Parks and Resorts - Vi utvecklar hela webblösningen inhouse i samarbete med kundens redaktörer och produktägare för samtliga parker. Den tekniska plattformen utvecklas med contentful/gatsby och .NET/Azure. Vi har blivit uppmärksammade nationellt för detta arbete, dels med ett silver i Svenska Designpriset 2019 för Kolmården, en nominering i Svenska Designpriset 2020 för Gröna Lund (prisutdelningen har ännu inte skett så vi vet inte var vi landar) samt Kolmården seger i IDG topp-100 för bästa turismsajt.
Filmstaden - Har du bokat/köpt biobiljett? Kanske inte på sistone men innan året som gud glömde gjorde du antagligen det har du använt vår lösning. Vi ansvarar för all extern webb samt vissa interna delar. Med denna sajt vann vi IDG topp100 2018 (då SF Bio). Webben utvecklas i en episervermiljö med .NET och Azure.

Vi tror att du har:

Ca 5 års erfarenhet av att arbeta skarpt som utvecklare. Det är viktigt att du arbetat i enterprise-projekt med webb för många slutanvändare.
.NET och Azure-kompetens

Det är meriterande om du har:

Kapacitet att ta tead-roll i våra projekt.
Kompetens inom Episerver och Contentful-erfarenhet, Xamarin
Erfarenhet som konsult

Vi erbjuder

Vi är en flexibel arbetsplats som kommer erbjuda distansarbete även när pandemin är över. För dem som vill jobba från kontoret på Sveavägen är det bara att komma in och jobba, dem som föredrar distansarbete kommer jobba primärt hemifrån men vara på kontoret 1-2 dagar i veckan i alla fall av primärt sociala skäl. Vi vill inte bara vara en namnlista på Slack. Utöver den naturliga komptensutvecklingen som sker av att arbeta i team med likasinnade erbjuder vi både externa och interna utbildningar. Vi startar exempelvis ett nytt initiativ vi kallar Kompetensnätverk - Från utvecklare till arkitekt, där en av våra lösningsarkitekter guidar dem som vill mot mer kunskap inom arkitektur för att förbereda dig för en roll som lösningsarkitekt om du så önskar.

Läs mer om hur det är att jobba på B3 och Rebel and Bird och hur vi arbetar med wellness och våra sociala initiativ här

Klicka på ansökan eller tveka inte att kontakta Jocke Ginsburg på telefonnummer: 073-8133010 eller email: jocke@rebelandbird.com

jobs.title: (Senior) Software Engineer (Customer Identity) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 12 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

(Senior) Software Engineer (m/f/d)

(unlimited, full-time) to join our team located in Tallinn, Berlin or Stockholm

In this role, you will be a software development expert in an agile product development team, building and maintaining Riverty's Customer Identity Platform.

The Customer Identity Platform enables millions of consumers to securely use Riverty products, while providing seamless technical integration and frictionless user experience. Customer Identity Team is responsible for identifying or authenticating good consumers while recognizing and blocking bad actors to protect our consumers, merchants, partners, and Riverty from fraud.

On a daily basis you will

Design, develop, test, document, and operate robust, maintainable software for the Customer Identity Platform.
Participate in the end-to-end product development process and help the team ensure value, usability, feasibility, and viability.
Collaborate as needed with product managers, designers, architects, and other roles to discover the right solutions.
Monitor system health and application metrics for our live-critical platform. Investigate and resolve incidents as needed.
Identify issues, suggest improvements to new and existing features, and present ideas for solutions. Take initiative to improve quality across accessibility, performance, consistency, maintainability, and robustness.
Seek out, evaluate, and recommend new technologies and concepts, helping bring industry standards and best practices into our codebase and architecture.

Qualifications

You will be a strong fit if you have

At least 5 years of professional experience with .NET/C# development.
Strong expertise in RESTful APIs and backend service design.
Experience with microservices architecture, distributed systems, and asynchronous/event-driven communication.
Solid knowledge of application and information security.
Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), and modern deployment practices; familiarity with Kubernetes, MongoDB, and Infrastructure as Code is a plus.
Hands-on experience with front-end technologies including TypeScript (React is a plus), or a strong willingness to work full-stack.
Openness to participating in on-call rotations.
Experience with identity and access management technologies, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, Auth0, and PingOne AIC.

As a person you are

Self-driven, proactive, and solution-oriented.
Confident in communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.
Fluent in English.
Empathetic, collaborative, and receptive to giving and receiving feedback.

Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

As a Backend Engineer, you'll join our Sunbeam Labs, where we’re creating digital services that range from energy optimization to virtual power plants. You’ll work closely with a talented and energetic team of engineers and domain experts, all focused on building cutting-edge software solutions that make energy optimization a reality for our customers.

In this role, you’ll be involved in every stage of the software development lifecycle, from brainstorming ideas to deployment and ongoing maintenance. Since we’re pioneering services that haven’t existed before, there’s plenty of room for discovery and problem-solving! You’ll be working with thousands of connected devices that we control in real-time, based on measurements taken multiple times per second. Your daily challenges might include figuring out how to distribute work among devices, handling AWS datacenter failovers without a hitch, counting milliseconds and megawatts, and even predicting tomorrow’s sunshine.

If you love tackling challenges, writing code, and having fun while doing it, this could be the

perfect fit for you!

A value-driven workplace

– grow, take responsibility, and power up as both we and the energy industry evolve.

Diversity and inclusivity
– different perspectives drive innovation. Here, you can be yourself and contribute with your experiences, identities, and ideas.

Are we a match?

You value team success over personal success
10+ years of experience as a backend developer, preferably with C#
You’re a strong problem solver who enjoys taking on challenges

Knowledge of cloud technologies (we use AWS)
Experience in the energy sector

We are a hybrid team that meets at our office in Alvik Strand 3 times a week.

As Sweden’s - and one of Europe’s - leading providers of energy tech and solar, we help our customers optimize their energy use with smart, connected solutions. From solar panels to heat pumps, batteries, EV chargers, and software, we’re shaping the future of energy. We call it The Power Shift

.

Omsätta verksamhetsbehov till hållbara tekniska lösningar

Our sovereign AI platform is already used by 70+ municipalities, governments, and institutions. We've built a leading position in Sweden and are expanding across Europe.

What You'll Do

Be the technical owner within customer engagements, working alongside sales and customer success from pre-sales through go-live
Build integrations across APIs, authentication systems, data pipelines, and document platforms
Deploy Intric in on-prem and private cloud environments with strict security requirements
Debug what no one else can figure out, in environments with limited tooling and high constraints
Turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions customers rely on daily
Prioritize ruthlessly across competing demands, from a position of knowledge rather than whoever is loudest
Feed real-world deployment insights back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap

Who you are

You've shipped things that other people depend on. You've been on-call when they broke. You've dealt with real production risk, real failure, and end-to-end ownership without a safety net. That background is what makes the rest of this possible.

You work across the full stack without needing to hand off: frontend, backend, infrastructure, AI layer, GitOps, networking, protocols, raw API work
You take ownership of customer outcomes, not individual tasks. If the customer isn't reaching their goal, that's your problem to solve.
You can say no to the wrong thing and yes to the right one, even under pressure from the customer.
You can explain a technical decision to a non-technical department manager and defend it to their engineers, often in the same meeting
You're effective in ambiguous, under-documented, high-constraint environments

Fluent
Swedish and English are both required for this role.

Your title might have been Implementation Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or something else entirely. What matters is what you actually did: owning delivery in customer environments, end to end, with real stakes attached.

What You'll Gain

You'll build a combination that's hard to find elsewhere: production-level AI deployment experience in high-security environments, across multiple industries, with direct ownership of customer outcomes from start to finish.

Hands-on experience deploying AI in production-critical, high-security environments
Exposure to complex enterprise architectures across sectors and countries
Direct influence on product direction through real deployment feedback

What this job actually looks like

Up to 80% of your work happens in customer environments, alongside their technical teams primarly across Sweden with some cross-Nordics travel as projects require
. You learn their systems, integrate the platform, and own the outcome from the first sales conversation through go-live and beyond.

The environment spans Python, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, self-hosted LLMs, and Svelte. You won't use all of it on every project, but you need to move across the stack as the situation demands. You use AI tools well and quickly, but your value is the judgment behind them: knowing what to build, how to prioritize, and when to push back.

Your default is finding the path, not describing the obstacle. Sometimes that means telling a customer that what they're asking for is the wrong thing to build. Both are part of the job.

Why Intric

One of Europe's most trusted AI platforms for regulated organizations

High ownership and decision-making authority from day one
A team that takes quality, security, and long-term trust seriously

jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
AI is already changing how work gets done at CatalystOne. We're looking for someone who can design, build and operate AI solutions that create real business value, removing manual work, improving processes and helping colleagues focus on higher-value work.

The whole company is your remit, the work is already underway, and we're small enough that something you build can be used by colleagues within weeks. This is an opportunity to help shape an AI practice from the beginning and see your work create visible impact across the business.

At CatalystOne, we help organisations create better workplaces through HR technology. Across the Nordics, we combine technology, people expertise and business understanding to help customers improve how work gets done. We're now applying the same thinking internally as we continue to expand how AI supports our own organisation.

About the AI Hub

The AI Hub is a new function within People & Technology, created to help CatalystOne identify, prioritise and realise the value of AI across the business.

We don't see AI as purely a technology topic. Introducing AI changes how work is organised, what people need to learn, and where human judgement matters most. We want those conversations considered together, close to the people doing the work.

The purpose of the AI Hub is to bring together process improvement, organisational change and technology to help teams work better and deliver stronger outcomes. As our AI Operations Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning ideas into solutions that people use every day.

The role

Your users are your colleagues.
You'll build the systems, automations and AI-powered solutions that consultants, support teams, sales teams and back-office functions rely on to do their work. You'll work directly with the people experiencing the problem, helping shape solutions that fit how work actually happens.

This is a small team with a short path from idea to implementation. Some opportunities can move from a conversation on Monday to a solution in production that same week. Others require deeper technical design, data modelling or integration work. You'll help make those calls and take ownership of what gets built long after launch.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager to assess opportunities and agree scope. The AI Business Partner leads process improvement, adoption and value measurement. You lead technical design, engineering and operations. Both of you are involved while the problem is being defined and stay close after launch to ensure solutions create lasting value.

Some examples of what is already live
This isn't a greenfield AI initiative. We already have solutions creating value across CatalystOne today, including:
An AI support agent that resolves around a fifth of internal IT tickets before they reach the IT team.
Data products that save consultants time and provide business insights we didn't previously have.
Automated workflows that reduce manual administration and move information seamlessly between teams.

The AI Hub exists to build on that foundation, helping CatalystOne identify the next opportunities, improve how work gets done, and ensure new solutions deliver measurable business value.

What you'll do

You'll typically be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of a solution, from the first conversation through to operation and continuous improvement.Your work will include:
Building AI agents, automations and integrations that remove manual work and improve how teams operate.
Working directly with colleagues to understand problems and shape practical solutions.
Designing data models, workflows and integrations that support reliable AI solutions.
Deciding where automation makes sense, where AI adds value and where human judgement should remain part of the process.
Owning the solutions you build, including reliability, monitoring, security and cost management.
Improving solutions based on how people actually use them.
Creating documentation and reusable patterns that allow others to understand, maintain and extend your work.

Our technology stack

Today we use Claude Code and Anthropic models, our own MCP servers running on Azure Container Apps, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions and Logic Apps. We already have agentic workflows running in production.

The tools will change. If something better comes along and you can make the case for it, you'll have room to improve the setup. Whatever we run needs to be secure, understandable, maintainable and cost-effective.

What we're looking for

We're less interested in a specific career path than in your ability to build reliable solutions that people depend on.You'll likely bring:
Experience building integrations, backend services, automations or internal platforms.
Strong technical foundations in areas such as Azure, Microsoft Graph, APIs, serverless technologies, Python or C#.
Experience delivering AI-powered solutions that real users rely on.
Good technical judgement and the ability to choose simple solutions when they solve the problem.
An understanding of security, reliability and operational ownership.
Awareness of the trade-offs between capability, speed, complexity and cost.
The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues.

You care about the work behind the request, not just the technology. You want to understand how people use what you've built, whether they trust it and how it can be improved over time.
You don't need HR or HCM experience. If this sounds broadly like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What success looks like

Your first few weeks will be about understanding our infrastructure, the solutions already running and the colleagues who use them.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager on new opportunities, helping assess what is technically possible and where the best place to start might be.
We want you building early, while giving you enough time to understand the environment you're responsible for.

By day 90, we'd expect you to have taken ownership of parts of the existing platform, contributed to new solutions entering production, and built strong relationships with the colleagues using them.

Why join CatalystOne?

This is an opportunity to help build an AI practice from the beginning and see your work used by colleagues across the company.You'll have the chance to:
Build solutions that create visible business impact.
Work directly with the people using what you build.
Shape how the AI Hub develops.
Experiment with modern AI technologies while staying focused on real business outcomes.
Take ownership from idea through production and continuous improvement.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, solve meaningful business problems and help shape the future of work at CatalystOne, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

As well as your salary, you’ll receive:
Generous time off: A solid vacation allowance so you can recharge and regroup.
Financial and health security: A comprehensive pension and insurance package, including private healthcare.
Your well being, your way: A wellness contribution to help you stay on top of your health.
Tech tools for efficiency: Laptop, mobile phone with subscription, and a home internet allowance.
Flexible work setup: A hybrid model that supports your work life balance, with at least three days a week in the office.
And more: Local benefits vary slightly by office, and we are happy to walk you through the details.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence
, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Cloud Architect,
you will be part of our global Forward Deployed Engineering organization, working with rapidly growing companies in EMEA and around the world. This role sits within FDE Delivery
and focuses on our install base, product adoption and customer health.

You will:

Lead the design and implementation of production-grade ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS (with awareness of multi-cloud environments).
Act as a hands-on expert and trusted advisor for customers running AI/ML workloads at scale, from initial discovery through deployment and optimization.
Translate complex business problems into cloud architectures that are secure, reliable, cost-efficient, and observable.
Help evolve how DoiT uses AI/ML internally and with customers by turning one-off solutions into reusable patterns and “gravel roads” that influence the product roadmap.
You will focus more on install base health, product adoption, proactive engagements, and account-team work.

Responsibilities

Core – Deep Cloud Expertise

Be the trusted cloud engineer customers lean on for high‑impact technical optimization work across cost, reliability, security, and performance.

Design and help implement solutions that:

improve cost efficiency (rightsizing, reservations/commitments, storage optimization, etc.)
increase reliability and resilience (HA/DR architectures, SLO/SLA‑aware designs)
strengthen security posture (IAM, network segmentation, data protection, least‑privilege)
reduce operational toil (automation, self‑service, guardrails, policy enforcement)
Plan and deliver structured engagements such as Cloud Optimization Sessions, cost/efficiency/performance workshops, security posture or reliability reviews, and architecture deep dives / "well‑architected" style assessments.
Respond to Expert Inquiry / support requests that require deep cloud engineering expertise, ensuring high‑quality, well‑explained resolutions.
Bring domain depth in:
ML / GenAI – deploying and operating ML/GenAI workloads (training and inference), GPU utilization, scaling, and cost control; MLOPS and integrating workloads with monitoring, logging, and FinOps; safe and efficient use of managed AI services.

Builder – Product Feedback & Contribution

Turn one‑off field work into reusable assets that improve both customer outcomes and the product itself.

Convert one‑off customer solutions into Gravel Roads - reusable patterns such as playbooks, Terraform modules, CloudFlow templates, cloud diagrams, Composer Recipes -> DCI Insights, and internal /external documentation.
Provide structured feedback to the DoiT Product and Engineering teams on:
product gaps and friction points discovered in real‑world usage
new opportunities for automation and workload lenses within DCI
telemetry and tracking that would make future FDE work more efficient

Contribute directly to DCI where appropriate - from feature requests and feedback, to contributing code, to owning specific DCI features end‑to‑end.
Build agent skills, scripts, and internal tooling that codify your expertise and scale it across the team.
Contribute to internal enablement: share learnings via documentation, demos, office hours, or training sessions for other FDEs and Customer Success team members.

Account Team – Embedded Execution

Operate as an embedded technical partner inside the account team.

Work in the account team model alongside Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Account Managers (AMs) to deliver impactful outcomes.
Own the technical depth lane: technical deployment & integration, automation & platform adoption, signal‑based proactive engagement, and most importantly, repeatable Cloud Optimization solutions.
Partner with customers' engineers, architects, and FinOps teams to translate vague pain points into concrete technical optimization plans — and help them ship changes that stick and create continuous value.
Co‑deliver complex or multi‑domain engagements with peer FDEs (for example, infra + data + ML/GenAI), reviewing and refining designs, and engagement plans together.
Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both engineers and non‑technical stakeholders (FinOps, finance, leadership), and maintain clear documentation of architectures, decisions, and implemented changes so customers and fellow FDEs can sustain and build on your work.
Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement within the global FDE community through design reviews, internal forums, enablement sessions, and experimentation.

Product Expert – DoiT Cloud Intelligence™ (DCI)

Become an expert in DCI and use it hands‑on to drive concrete customer outcomes.

Master DoiT Cloud Intelligence™ products and services — including Cloud Analytics, DCI Insights, Cloud Composer, CloudFlow, DataHub, PerfectScale, and other Enterprise Platforms.
Use DCI hands‑on to:
Build and operationalize Cloud Analytics and Allocations to create dashboards and reports for customer engineering, finance, and leadership.
Use DCI Insights to identify and prioritize cost, risk, and reliability opportunities, and shepherd them through to closure.
Implement Cloud Composer queries, build recipes that result in hand-crafted insights across all customers' engineering use cases.
Build CloudFlow automations (e.g., anomaly routing, scheduled actions, guardrails, policy enforcement).
Use Built in Integrations such and utilize DataHub and other workload‑intelligence features to optimize key business and workload data inside DCI.

Help customers embed DCI into existing observability, CI/CD, and governance processes so it becomes trusted and indispensable in day‑to‑day cloud operations.

Experience

4+ years of experience architecting, deploying, and managing cloud-based AI/ML solutions, including production workloads.
Proven track record designing and operating large, distributed systems on AWS, selecting appropriate services and patterns to meet business and technical goals.

AWS & GenAI / ML Expertise

Advanced proficiency with AWS services relevant to AI/ML and GenAI.
Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock for deploying and scaling foundation models and Generative AI workloads.
Experience fine-tuning and deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) and multimodal AI using Amazon SageMaker (including JumpStart).

Proficiency integrating TensorFlow, PyTorch, and other ML frameworks with SageMaker for model development, fine-tuning, and deployment.

Proven ability to mentor peers, run enablement sessions, and collaborate across Sales, CS, and Product.

Natural ownership mentality: you escalate early, resolve fast, and own the outcome.

Familiarity with Hugging Face or similar open-source ecosystems integrated with AWS.

Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

Enterprise Application Support Engineer

The Enterprise Application Support Engineer serves as a technical resource responsible for ensuring the reliability, performance, and operational stability of enterprise applications and cloud-based platforms. This role combines advanced technical troubleshooting, customer-facing support, systems engineering, and process improvement to deliver exceptional service for mission-critical business applications.

As a technical escalation point within the Customer Support organization, the Enterprise Application Support Engineer partners with Engineering, Product Management, Implementation, Infrastructure, and Customer Success teams to resolve complex production issues, improve operational efficiency, and enhance customer experience. The role requires deep technical expertise in cloud platforms, enterprise integrations, automation, and application support, along with strong communication and leadership skills.

This position is ideal for experienced engineers who enjoy solving challenging technical problems, mentoring others, improving support operations through automation, and building scalable support processes.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Application Support

Serve as the highest technical escalation point for complex customer issues involving enterprise applications and cloud-based platforms.
Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve production incidents involving application functionality, integrations, databases, APIs, and infrastructure.
Investigate software defects, configuration issues, performance bottlenecks, and integration failures across multiple micro-service platforms.
Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and assist core engineering teams develop long-term corrective actions to prevent recurring issues.
Monitor application health, performance, and availability to proactively identify operational risks.

Customer Support & Technical Leadership

Serve as the primary technical advisor for strategic enterprise customers and communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Manage multiple customer cases simultaneously while meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Coordinate customer communications during critical incidents and major outages.

Validate customer configurations and recommend operational best practices.

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational tasks.
Develop scripts and tooling to improve support efficiency.
Recommend improvements to monitoring, alerting, and operational workflows.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance platform reliability and customer satisfaction.

What We’re Looking For

Strong understanding of cloud-native technologies and Kubernetes.
Experience using Git for source control and collaboration.
Experience with SQL and relational database troubleshooting.
Experience supporting REST APIs and enterprise integrations.
Knowledge of incident management, change management, and problem management processes.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
AI is already changing how work gets done at CatalystOne. We're looking for someone who can design, build and operate AI solutions that create real business value, removing manual work, improving processes and helping colleagues focus on higher-value work.

The whole company is your remit, the work is already underway, and we're small enough that something you build can be used by colleagues within weeks. This is an opportunity to help shape an AI practice from the beginning and see your work create visible impact across the business.

At CatalystOne, we help organisations create better workplaces through HR technology. Across the Nordics, we combine technology, people expertise and business understanding to help customers improve how work gets done. We're now applying the same thinking internally as we continue to expand how AI supports our own organisation.

About the AI Hub

The AI Hub is a new function within People & Technology, created to help CatalystOne identify, prioritise and realise the value of AI across the business.

We don't see AI as purely a technology topic. Introducing AI changes how work is organised, what people need to learn, and where human judgement matters most. We want those conversations considered together, close to the people doing the work.

The purpose of the AI Hub is to bring together process improvement, organisational change and technology to help teams work better and deliver stronger outcomes. As our AI Operations Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning ideas into solutions that people use every day.

The role

Your users are your colleagues.
You'll build the systems, automations and AI-powered solutions that consultants, support teams, sales teams and back-office functions rely on to do their work. You'll work directly with the people experiencing the problem, helping shape solutions that fit how work actually happens.

This is a small team with a short path from idea to implementation. Some opportunities can move from a conversation on Monday to a solution in production that same week. Others require deeper technical design, data modelling or integration work. You'll help make those calls and take ownership of what gets built long after launch.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager to assess opportunities and agree scope. The AI Business Partner leads process improvement, adoption and value measurement. You lead technical design, engineering and operations. Both of you are involved while the problem is being defined and stay close after launch to ensure solutions create lasting value.

Some examples of what is already live
This isn't a greenfield AI initiative. We already have solutions creating value across CatalystOne today, including:
An AI support agent that resolves around a fifth of internal IT tickets before they reach the IT team.
Data products that save consultants time and provide business insights we didn't previously have.
Automated workflows that reduce manual administration and move information seamlessly between teams.

The AI Hub exists to build on that foundation, helping CatalystOne identify the next opportunities, improve how work gets done, and ensure new solutions deliver measurable business value.

What you'll do

You'll typically be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of a solution, from the first conversation through to operation and continuous improvement.Your work will include:
Building AI agents, automations and integrations that remove manual work and improve how teams operate.
Working directly with colleagues to understand problems and shape practical solutions.
Designing data models, workflows and integrations that support reliable AI solutions.
Deciding where automation makes sense, where AI adds value and where human judgement should remain part of the process.
Owning the solutions you build, including reliability, monitoring, security and cost management.
Improving solutions based on how people actually use them.
Creating documentation and reusable patterns that allow others to understand, maintain and extend your work.

Our technology stack

Today we use Claude Code and Anthropic models, our own MCP servers running on Azure Container Apps, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions and Logic Apps. We already have agentic workflows running in production.

The tools will change. If something better comes along and you can make the case for it, you'll have room to improve the setup. Whatever we run needs to be secure, understandable, maintainable and cost-effective.

What we're looking for

We're less interested in a specific career path than in your ability to build reliable solutions that people depend on.You'll likely bring:
Experience building integrations, backend services, automations or internal platforms.
Strong technical foundations in areas such as Azure, Microsoft Graph, APIs, serverless technologies, Python or C#.
Experience delivering AI-powered solutions that real users rely on.
Good technical judgement and the ability to choose simple solutions when they solve the problem.
An understanding of security, reliability and operational ownership.
Awareness of the trade-offs between capability, speed, complexity and cost.
The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues.

You care about the work behind the request, not just the technology. You want to understand how people use what you've built, whether they trust it and how it can be improved over time.
You don't need HR or HCM experience. If this sounds broadly like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What success looks like

Your first few weeks will be about understanding our infrastructure, the solutions already running and the colleagues who use them.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager on new opportunities, helping assess what is technically possible and where the best place to start might be.
We want you building early, while giving you enough time to understand the environment you're responsible for.

By day 90, we'd expect you to have taken ownership of parts of the existing platform, contributed to new solutions entering production, and built strong relationships with the colleagues using them.

Why join CatalystOne?

This is an opportunity to help build an AI practice from the beginning and see your work used by colleagues across the company.You'll have the chance to:
Build solutions that create visible business impact.
Work directly with the people using what you build.
Shape how the AI Hub develops.
Experiment with modern AI technologies while staying focused on real business outcomes.
Take ownership from idea through production and continuous improvement.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, solve meaningful business problems and help shape the future of work at CatalystOne, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

Generous time off: A solid vacation allowance so you can recharge and regroup.
Financial and health security: A comprehensive pension and insurance package, including private healthcare.
Your well being, your way: A wellness contribution to help you stay on top of your health.
Tech tools for efficiency: Laptop, mobile phone with subscription, and a home internet allowance.

Domain Driven Design is the backbone of our design thinking, elements of the Microservices style drive the deployment. The Event Driven Architecture style and CQRS are means of achieving the right decoupling.

Strong understanding of cloud-native technologies and distributed system design.

jobs.description:
WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

As our new Senior Software Engineer, you will join SimCorp's Product Division, a full-scale agile organization. You will be working in an agile team of about 5-7 people in the Portfolio Analysis Product Area. The team works on our SimCorp Dimension product and on capabilities used by investment professionals to understand portfolios, performance and risk.

In your daily work you will, together with your team, understand and review customer requirements, discuss solutions, implement and test the chosen solution, and support it. We use a variety of tools, but the main ones are C#, Dyalog APL and Oracle database. You will mainly be working with backend components, APIs and services.

The present and near future main topics are good maintainability, high system performance, continuous integration and delivery, and reshaping parts of our product for the cloud. We are not modernizing for the sake of fashion. We are doing it because our products are business critical, widely used and need to keep evolving in a careful way.

AI Is Part Of How We Work Every Day

We use AI every day and see it as a natural part of modern software engineering, alongside source control, testing, CI/CD and code reviews. We actively look for ways to integrate AI into our work whenever it creates real benefit for our customers, products, teams or engineers. AI does not replace engineering judgment. It helps good engineers learn faster, reduce repetitive work, explore alternatives and build better software.

In addition to implementing customer features, it is essential for us to continuously improve on all levels: company, division, product area, team and individual.

We encourage personal development, curiosity and experimentation. Every sixth sprint is reserved for planning, innovation, learning and improvements, giving you regular opportunities to explore new technologies, improve something important, or try out ideas that may benefit you, your team or the application.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. We are looking for a developer who enjoys real product engineering: understanding the problem, discussing trade-offs, writing good software, ensuring quality and improving the system over time.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be expected to help lead beyond writing code. You will contribute to design discussions, help the team make good technical decisions, improve maintainability and performance, and support the software you help build.

Designing, developing and maintaining backend functionality and APIs using C# and .NET
Working with Dyalog APL and other technologies where they are part of the product
Contributing to cloud modernization and scalable service design where it adds real value
Improving performance, maintainability, testability and developer experience
Using CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews as natural parts of daily engineering work
Using AI every day as part of practical engineering work, including exploring ideas, understanding unfamiliar code, generating prototypes, improving tests, documenting decisions and automating routine tasks
Working with the team to discover where AI can create real value in our development process and where human engineering judgment should lead
Collaborating with product owners, domain experts and fellow engineers to turn customer needs into good software solutions
Supporting the team in continuously improving both the product and the way we work

What We Expect From You

We expect you to know some of the following and be able to, and interested in, learning the rest:

C# and .NET development
Backend development and API design
Building high-performance, scalable and maintainable applications
Continuous integration and delivery
Automated testing and practical quality engineering
Working with relational databases, such as Oracle or similar
Cloud technologies, distributed systems or Azure-based services
A willingness to learn additional technologies, including Dyalog APL
Curiosity about AI-assisted software engineering and how it can improve daily development work

Practical experience within financial instruments and financial investment systems is an advantage, but not a prerequisite for the job. It is more important that you take an interest in learning this field. We will bring you up to speed using technical and domain discussions, training, and a comprehensive onboarding program.

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important than your ability to learn, collaborate, and handle responsibilities.

We value people who are good at several of the following and interested in improving the rest:

Leading your work and achieving results
Trying new approaches to both new and old challenges
Working with others to leverage the abilities of everyone in the team
Learning new skills and improving upon existing ones
Looking continuously for ways to improve what we do and how we do it
Comparing technical quality with business value
Using modern tools, especially AI tools, every day where they help us build better software and become better engineers
Contributing to an inclusive, trust-based and collaborative engineering culture

How We Work

We believe good software engineering is a team activity. Quality is not something handed over at the end. It is built into the way we discuss requirements, design solutions, write code, test, review, deploy and learn from production feedback.

We also believe senior engineers should have room to think. We do not expect you to chase every trend. We expect you to apply sound engineering judgment, use modern practices where they help, and help us evolve a large and widely used product in a way that is sustainable for clients, users and engineers.

AI is one of the modern practices we take seriously. We do not view AI as a separate area of engineering. We view it as another tool in the engineering toolbox. Just as we continuously adopted better testing, automation and cloud technologies, we expect AI to become a natural part of how we design, build, document, test, maintain and improve software.

Benefits

Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
Self- Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
Inclusive and diverse company culture
Pension and health benefits and bonus
Work-life balance – We strongly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self’s, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for helping us mitigate bias in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you.
