jobs.title: Commercial Domain Architect
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you a highly skilled architect who can turn complex commercial, digital, data and artificial intelligence choices into clear direction? Join Lundbeck as Commercial Domain Architect and help shape our commercial digital ecosystem.

In this role, you will be the design authority for the commercial digital domain across customer relationship management, customer engagement, omnichannel, content, analytics, commercial data and artificial intelligence-enabled workflows. You will help create a coherent ecosystem that can scale across markets while balancing global consistency, local relevance, speed, flexibility and long-term sustainability.

Your new role

As Commercial Domain Architect, you will own and evolve the target architecture for Lundbeck’s commercial digital domain, translating commercial priorities into clear architectural direction across platforms, integrations, data and future capabilities.

A key part of your role will be navigating complex trade-offs where there is rarely one perfect answer — for example global standardisation versus local flexibility, platform-native versus modular approaches, and speed of delivery versus long-term scalability.

You will work closely with the Head of Architecture & Design, solution architects, commercial stakeholders, colleagues across data, artificial intelligence, security and operations, and external partners. You will be a trusted sparring partner for the solution architects, helping them navigate design choices, challenge assumptions and keep solutions aligned with the broader commercial target architecture.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Shape the commercial architecture

Own and evolve the target architecture across customer relationship management, customer engagement, omnichannel, content, analytics, commercial data and artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities.
Define how customer, account, engagement, content, consent, insight and performance data connect across the commercial ecosystem.
Define platform boundaries, integration patterns and solution principles that enable interoperability, reuse and future flexibility across the organisation.

Provide strategic design authority

Act as the architectural design authority for the commercial domain and assess solution fit within agreed enterprise principles and guardrails.
Provide clear recommendations on strategic trade-offs and make the rationale understandable to both senior stakeholders and technical teams.
Identify and challenge designs that could create unnecessary duplication, technical debt, weak interoperability, vendor dependency or constraints on future scalability and innovation.

Enable data and artificial intelligence

Ensure the commercial architecture supports trusted, well-governed and artificial intelligence-ready data and insights.
Shape the architectural foundation for scalable artificial intelligence workflows and future artificial intelligence-enabled customer engagement.
Connect commercial architecture with wider enterprise capabilities across data, artificial intelligence, integration, security and operations.

Guide solutions from architecture to delivery

Act as a senior sparring partner for solution architects and guide external partners so detailed designs remain aligned with the commercial target architecture and agreed design principles.
Challenge technology and implementation partners on data models, integration, extensibility, compliance, scalability, vendor dependency and long-term cost.
Provide architectural recommendations and risk assessments that inform platform, vendor, investment and roadmap decisions.

Your future team

You will join the Architecture & Design team within Commercial Digital Enablement, part of Lundbeck’s Enterprise Digital Enablement organisation. The team connects commercial priorities with enterprise architecture and solution design, helping Lundbeck develop digital capabilities that can be reused and scaled across markets.

You will report to the Head of Architecture & Design. As Commercial Domain Architect, you will provide professional architecture authority for the commercial domain and act as a senior sparring partner for solution architects, the Delivery Lead and stakeholders across Commercial, Data, Artificial Intelligence, Security and Operations.

The position has no direct people-management responsibility, but you will have significant professional influence through your role as the architectural authority for the commercial digital domain.

The role is based at our headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark. Given the collaborative and leadership nature of the role, frequent in-office presence is required.

What You Bring To The Team

We are looking for a highly talented architect who combines strong technical judgement with commercial understanding, pragmatic decision-making and excellent communication skills. You bring:

8+ years of experience in domain architecture, solution architecture, enterprise architecture or senior platform roles.
Strong understanding of commercial capabilities within life sciences, including customer relationship management, customer engagement, customer and account data, and analytics.
Experience shaping target architectures and designing scalable digital ecosystems across multiple markets or business units.
Strong understanding of data, artificial intelligence, integration, platform architecture and governance.
Experience assessing platform and ecosystem choices and challenging technology vendors and implementation partners.
The ability to assess complex architectural trade-offs and advise senior stakeholders in practical business language.
A collaborative working style, with the ability to build trust and create alignment across business, digital, data, artificial intelligence and technology teams.
The confidence to act as a constructive sparring partner for solution architects, helping translate architectural principles into practical solution design.
A strong enterprise mindset, with the ability to balance local requirements with scalability, interoperability and long-term sustainability.

Our promise to you

Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. We want to go faster and further in addressing the significant unmet needs of people living with brain disorders. We offer rewarding careers with exciting challenges and development opportunities, balanced with initiatives focused on your well-being.

Annual base salary range: 786 000 - 1 081 300 DKK gross

At Lundbeck, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. Please note that the final base salary within the stated range will be based on relevant qualifications, skills, competencies, and level of proficiency as well as internal pay equity.

We need every brain in the game, and at Lundbeck, we are committed to building a workforce that is as diverse as the people we serve. Read more about our commitment at www.lundbeck.com/global/about-us/our-commitment/diversity-and-inclusion.

jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
About Apylon and the opportunity

Apylon is building agents for the most complex workflow out there - financial admin in healthcare.
Hospitals and payers move billions of euros through fragmented, manual workflows shaped by clinical data, payer rules, contracts, and local coding systems. We believe this is a data, machine-learning, and automation problem disguised as financial operations.

We are live with leading private hospitals and expanding quickly. Every hospital presents a different challenge: EHR systems are configured differently, national coding rules vary, and contracts describe the same clinical event in different terms. Your job is to help us turn that complexity into a system that learns: each new integration should make the next one faster, safer, and less expensive.

Apylon is backed by experienced operators and top-tier investors in healthcare and fintech. Our team draws on experience from Zendesk, Pleo, Wawa Fertility, Sibill, and some of the largest multi-country hospital groups in Europe. You’ll join the first small engineering team, with massive ownership over both what we build and how we build it.

Delivering healthcare is hard. Getting paid for it shouldn’t be.

You’ll be responsible for

Own EHR integrations end to end: APIs, schemas, undocumented behaviour, operational failure modes, and vendor changes.
Build reusable integration-platform primitives for extraction, normalisation, versioning, replay, monitoring, and observability.
Design the canonical data model that connects heterogeneous EHR data, reimbursement systems, national coding standards, and hospital-specific conventions.
Build reliable inputs for our billing agents, including the constraints, validation, and evaluation systems that make model-assisted decisions safe to use in production.
Work directly with hospital IT teams and EHR vendors: technical discovery, implementation, joint debugging, and onboarding.
Take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your work: design, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and iteration from real-world data.

Who you are

3+ years building and operating production systems in complex, messy domains. We care more about demonstrated judgment and ownership than an exact number of years.
Experience using LLMs as production components—not just developer tools. You understand when to use models, when deterministic systems are better, how to constrain outputs, and how to evaluate reliability.
Strong data-modelling instincts. You know when abstraction creates leverage and when it hides important real-world variation.
Comfort working from incomplete information. You form hypotheses, test them against data, and distinguish unknowns that can wait from assumptions that could invalidate the system.
Confidence in customer-facing technical work: discovery calls, debugging sessions, and direct conversations with vendors and hospital IT teams.
Experience with cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.
A practical, hands-on approach: equally comfortable designing an integration architecture and writing a quick script to answer an urgent question.

This role may be a strong fit if

You enjoy reverse-engineering systems you do not control, finding structure in messy real-world data, and turning one-off discoveries into reusable software. You are comfortable being the engineer in the room with customers and partners.

What this role is not

Consulting or bespoke delivery work. Each integration must improve the product and reduce the marginal cost of the next.
A role insulated from customers or operational reality.
Pure platform engineering or pure integration work: the value comes from doing both.
A role where incorrect mappings are merely technical defects. In this domain, they can produce incorrect invoices.

Bonus points

Experience with healthcare interoperability or coding standards, including HL7v2, FHIR, or national messaging and reimbursement standards.
Experience building and operating third-party integrations at scale.
Experience in healthcare, fintech, or another regulated environment.
Experience in an early-stage or fast-growing company.
Working proficiency in Danish, or German.

Our tech stack

Python · Django · React · PostgreSQL · AWS · K8s · Terraform · Bedrock
We’re pragmatic. You’ll have a big say in how it evolves.

What Apylon offers

The chance to solve one of Europe’s biggest healthcare inefficiencies.
Competitive salary + stock options (you’ll own part of what you build).
25 days of annual leave + local public holidays.
Lunch on us during workdays at the office.
Regular off-sites and social events. We like building together, not just working together.
Travel within the EU roughly monthly. Onboarding a hospital, working through an integration with a vendor’s engineers, or spending time on-site to understand how the data is actually produced. If travelling to a hospital basement to figure out why an export is malformed sounds like a bad week, this isn’t your role.

Working at Apylon means embarking on a highly ambitious mission to rebuild the financial infrastructure of European healthcare. We’re already live with leading private hospitals, processing thousands of invoices, proving that complex payer rules can be turned into code, powering transparent, automated, and intelligent revenue systems.

jobs.description:
About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (Agentic AI)
to join our Innovation team. The role embeds with enterprise clients remotely, with onsite visits as engagements require.

Position Summary

Reporting to the VP, Innovation, Solution Delivery, the Forward Deployed Engineer (Agentic AI) embeds with enterprise clients to design, build and operationalize agentic AI solutions in production. You will build production outcomes for clients, integrate agentic systems with enterprise platforms and systems of record, and stay accountable through cutover, early production and handover to ongoing support. The role is platform-agnostic by design and adapts to whichever AI platform best fits the client, including hyperscaler AI services, ServiceNow and other enterprise AI platforms.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Lead technical discovery, scope agentic AI use cases, and translate business problems into engineering deliverables with measurable success criteria such as cycle-time reduction, support deflection, automation rate, security and governance success rate and adoption rate.
Design target architectures that fit the client's environment, regulatory posture and platform preferences, selecting the right substrate per engagement across hyperscaler AI services, ServiceNow and other enterprise AI platforms.
Write production-grade code to deliver the solution, working inside the client's source control, CI/CD and deployment infrastructure, and within enterprise release governance including change approvals, separation of duties, audit evidence and rollback planning.
Build and tune retrieval pipelines, prompt architecture, guardrails, agent orchestration and human-in-the-loop controls that hold under real production variation.
Implement enterprise-safe agent tool execution, including permission scoping, approval gates, audit trails and rollback paths for any agent action that touches systems of record.
Build evaluation suites that catch hallucinations, regressions, grounding gaps and quality drift, and implement production observability for latency, token usage, error rates, accuracy and output drift.
Integrate solutions with client identity, secrets management, network controls, incident response and compliance tooling.
Stay engaged through cutover and the first production iteration cycle, then run a structured handover to the ongoing support team, including documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer.
Act as an escalation backup to the support team after handover, stepping back in when issues exceed the support team's depth or when the system needs architectural intervention.
Build trusted advisor relationships with client engineering, data, security and business stakeholders, and communicate clearly to both engineering teams and C-level audiences.
Abstract field learnings into reusable patterns, accelerators and reference architectures that feed back into Innovation and shape product direction, methodology and the next engagement.

Experience

This is a Principal-level role. We are looking for engineers with the depth to operate independently inside enterprise client environments, the breadth to span production engineering and applied AI, and the demonstrated ability to ship in a discipline that is still being defined. We weight recent, hands-on agentic AI work heavily, recognising that production agentic systems are a young discipline. Equivalent experience from adjacent disciplines, including machine learning engineering, applied AI research with production deployment exposure, or senior backend engineering with recent agentic shipping, is welcomed.

8+ years of professional engineering experience across production systems, with significant production rather than purely advisory time.
2+ years shipping AI or machine learning systems into production, with demonstrated hands-on agentic or LLM-based work.
Proven track record working directly with Fortune 500 or Global 2000 enterprise clients in ambiguous, complex environments.
Track record of operating across the full lifecycle of a system, including architecture ownership, handover to support and ongoing escalation support.
Demonstrated ability to learn fast and ship in emerging technical disciplines. Candidates whose recent agentic AI work was learned quickly on the back of strong fundamentals are explicitly in scope.
Enterprise systems-of-record grounding: hands-on experience with an ERP we support (SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite, JD Edwards), or strong business-process depth in core enterprise processes such as procurement, finance and order-to-cash. Direct SAP or Oracle E-Business Suite experience preferred.

Skills

ERP and enterprise systems experience across SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite, JD Edwards, infor, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Workday or other systems of record. Direct SAP and Oracle EBS experience highly valued. Required for ERP-anchored regional seats.
Experience with multiple agentic AI platforms, demonstrating ability to deliver on whichever platform the client has standardized on.
Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI Engineer or equivalent embedded delivery role at an AI lab, hyperscaler or systems integrator.
Production Python and at least one additional enterprise or full-stack language such as TypeScript, Java, Go, C# or Scala, including modern agent frameworks and patterns.
SQL and data modelling fluency, including the ability to reason about enterprise data quality, lineage, permissions and operational semantics.
Hands-on retrieval-augmented generation, including chunking, embeddings, vector stores and reranking.
Evaluation suite design for LLM-based systems, including regression detection, hallucination measurement and grounding checks.
Production observability for AI systems, including latency, token usage, error rate and output drift instrumentation.
Working knowledge of at least one major agentic AI platform such as AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, ServiceNow AI and willingness to learn others as engagements demand.
Agent tool execution and governance, including the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent tool interfaces, permission scoping, scoped credentials, approval gates, audit trails and safe execution controls.
Enterprise integration fundamentals, including REST and event-driven patterns, identity flows such as OIDC and SAML, and secure deployment into client-controlled environments.
UI and front-end fluency in modern web frameworks such as Angular, React or equivalent, sufficient to build or extend the user-facing layer of agentic solutions.
Durable execution frameworks, event-driven architectures or workflow orchestration at enterprise scale.
Exceptional written and verbal communication across deep technical and executive audiences, with strong consultative and outcomes-driven instincts. High autonomy, resilience and pragmatism in legacy and politically complex environments, with the proactive discipline needed for effective remote embedding.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Location

Remote - Singapore

Travel

Region-specific (see regional variants of this role). Travel typically 25 percent to work with clients, prospects, partners or attend events.

Why Rimini Street?

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

US and international recognition for industry leadership and philanthropic efforts. See all of our awards and recognitions here: https://www.riministreet.com/company/awards/

jobs.description:
Job Description

We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About The Role

Wiley is looking for a strong Solution Architect to join our ReX Review & Screening team in Iași, Romania. Research Exchange (ReX) is Wiley's publishing platform, built from components such as Review, Screening, and Commissions. As a Solution Architect, you will provide a holistic view of, and take ownership of, its infrastructure and supporting technologies, ensuring solutions meet business requirements and strategic direction for the long term in a secure, scalable, and cost-effective way. You'll partner closely with senior leaders, engineering and delivery teams, product managers, and development teams across these components to keep roadmaps aligned and guide well-considered technology decisions, all while remaining pragmatic.

Responsibilities

Provide a holistic view of, and ownership over, the platform's core and supporting technologies, building consensus on its future technical direction.
Make high-level technical decisions that influence all development teams, defining and communicating architectural solutions through code, where appropriate.
Understand the business context and vision for ReX, partnering with product teams to propose solutions that align with our direction.
Guide a cohesive technical direction across ReX's core components, helping each development team make well-aligned architectural choices as the platform evolves.
Lead scoping, architecture, and design across cloud and on-premises technologies, and drive multi-year architecture roadmaps.
Develop solutions using a cloud-first approach on AWS; establish strategies for secure identity, authentication, and authorization architectures; and lead security projects from conception through implementation.
Evaluate integration requirements for business solutions, ensuring adherence to architecture standards and information security policies.
Educate, support, and mentor development teams through training and hands-on collaboration, focusing on building the teams' own capabilities rather than creating dependency on you.
Continuously improve technical processes and practices, and implement quality assurance guidelines for testing, code quality, and deployment.
Stay ahead of industry trends, contribute to technology strategy and roadmaps, and maintain documentation of architectural decisions and standards.
Be part of the wider Research Architecture Group, contributing to pan-Wiley architecture policies, and conduct periodic skills gap analyses and training.

Requirements

Education & Experience

Degree in Computer Science or a related field (MSc preferred), or equivalent demonstrated experience; a minimum of 12 years in the software industry, including several years in an architecture or technical leadership capacity.
Proven track record in software and systems architecture and event-driven microservices, with deep expertise in the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem and cloud-native technologies on AWS.

Technical Expertise

Deep expertise across our stack (Node.js, TypeScript, Express, React, and GraphQL), with a proven track record of architecting event-driven, service-based systems.
Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) running on AWS, as well as CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code practices.
Strong understanding of cloud delivery models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and observability and monitoring practices for distributed, service-based architectures.

Nice to Have

Experience with Agile and Lean methodologies; a strong grasp of clean code principles, continuous delivery, and managing technical debt.
Familiarity with GraphQL schema design and message/event-based integration patterns; AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer or Solutions Architect) is a plus.

Skills & Behaviors

Strong strategic planning, decision-making, and organizational skills; self-motivated, accountable, and able to influence and drive change across teams.
An analytical, flexible, and proactive problem-solver, comfortable managing both short-term deliverables and long-term goals.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership; works well independently and collaboratively at all levels.
An advanced level of English is required.

We power infinite possibilities.

For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.

We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.

Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.

Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact tasupport@wiley.com for assistance.

We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility. Our values support courageous teammates, needle movers, and learning champions all while striving to support the health and well-being of all employees. We offer meeting-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow.

We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package. The range below represents Wiley's good faith and reasonable estimate of the base pay for this role at the time of posting roles in the United Kingdom, Canada, USA, Austria, Czechia, Denmark, France, Greece, Italy, Netherlands, Romania, or Spain. It is anticipated that most qualified candidates will fall within the range, however the ultimate salary offered for this role may be higher or lower and will be set based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies.

When applying, please attach your resume/CV to be considered.

23,042.00 RON to 38,408.00 RON

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst with .NET Background
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We are seeking an experienced Technical Business Analyst (Technical BA) with strong expertise in .NET applications, database analysis, and business analysis practices. The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding existing applications by analyzing source code, database structures, integrations, and business processes. The individual will work closely with business stakeholders, developers, QA teams, and project managers to translate business requirements into detailed technical user stories, functional specifications, and solution documents.

This role requires a unique combination of technical depth and business analysis skills to support application enhancements, modernization initiatives, and ongoing support activities.

What You'll Be Doing

Gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into clear functional and technical requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria
Analyse existing .NET applications, APIs, services, integrations and database structures to understand system functionality and dependencies
Review C#, .NET and SQL implementations to support reverse engineering of existing application functionality and business rules
Analyse data flows, database schemas, stored procedures, views, SQL jobs and system dependencies
Perform impact analysis for change requests, enhancements and defect resolution
Facilitate requirement gathering sessions and discussions between business stakeholders, Developers, Architects, QA teams and Project Managers
Document AS-IS and TO-BE processes, workflows, system interactions, data mappings and integration requirements
Develop functional and technical specifications that provide clear guidance to development teams
Collaborate with technical teams to identify solution approaches, dependencies, constraints and implementation impacts
Support system integration analysis across applications, APIs, databases and external platforms
Contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, requirement prioritization and delivery activities
Support QA teams with requirement clarification, test scenario preparation, UAT and defect triage
Create and maintain project documentation including user stories, process flows, technical specifications, data mappings and design decisions
Ensure requirements remain clear, traceable and aligned throughout the delivery lifecycle

What You'll Bring Along

Bachelor’s degree in Informatics or similar field of study, or equivalent working experience
Minimum 5+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst or similar role
Strong experience analyzing Microsoft .NET Framework / .NET Core applications
Ability to read and understand C#, ASP.NET MVC / Web API and .NET Core implementations
Strong SQL knowledge, including queries, stored procedures, database schemas, views and database dependencies
Experience with SQL Server, data modelling, database design concepts and data interfaces
Good understanding of REST APIs, application integrations and system data flows
Proven experience performing technical analysis, impact analysis and application reverse engineering
Strong experience with requirements elicitation, user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications
Experience documenting AS-IS and TO-BE processes, technical workflows and data mappings
Ability to facilitate discussions between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams
Advanced knowledge of Agile / Scrum methodology
Experience with Azure DevOps or Jira, Confluence, Visio / Draw.io and SQL Server Management Studio
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and documentation skills
Well-structured and organised working methodology
Excellent English verbal and written skills

Integrate 3rd party services, APIs, and external data sources with the backend architecture.

Work closely with front-end developers, designers, and product managers to deliver high-quality solutions and ensure the backend supports the needs of the front end.
Debug and resolve issues that arise in production environments.
Continuously improve the back-end architecture using emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry best practices.

Must have

Proven experience of at least 5-8 years as a Back-End Developer or in a similar role.
Strong proficiency in C#/.NET (dotNET), ASP.NET and REST APIs
Experience with web frameworks.
Experience with microservices or distributed backend architecture and serverless frameworks.
Hands-on experience with databases: SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases.
Knowledge of cloud native solutions, ideally Azure, and of cloud-based services.
Familiarity with version control systems.
Understanding of API development and integration.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and tools (e.g. JIRA, Confluence).

Ability to work with cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively with front-end developers, designers, and product managers.
Stay up to date with new technologies, frameworks, and tools to continuously enhance the backend systems.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Clear communication, both written and verbal, especially when collaborating with non-technical stakeholders.
Fluent proficiency in English (written and spoken).

Proficiency in PHP and Laravel.
Proficiency with Kubernetes and containerized applications.
Familiarity with containerization and CI/CD practices.
Experience with container orchestration tools.
Basic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
Knowledge of automated testing and test-driven development (TDD).
Familiarity with event-driven architecture and tools.
Knowledge of graph databases.

At Yusen Logistics you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, work alongside talented professionals, and grow your career in an environment that values innovation, accountability, and collaboration.

Apply now and help us power the digital supply chain solutions behind global healthcare logistics!

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (Desktop/SDK)
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

At Proton, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right and the cornerstone of democracy. Since our inception in 2014, founded by a team of scientists from CERN, we have dedicated ourselves to providing free and open-source technology to millions worldwide, ensuring access to privacy, security, and freedom online.

Our journey began with Proton Mail, the largest secure email service globally, and has since expanded to include Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, and Proton Pass. These tools empower individuals and organizations to take control of their personal data, break away from Big Tech’s invasive practices, and defeat censorship. Our work impacts hundreds of millions of lives, from activists on the front lines defending freedom to leaders in governments protecting sensitive information. In some cases, Proton’s services have even been instrumental in saving lives by enabling secure and private communications in high-risk situations.

Proton today supports over 100 million user accounts with a growing team of over 500 people from over 50 different countries, from the world's top companies and universities. We value intelligence, learning potential, and ambition in our hiring process. Adaptability is key as we navigate uncharted territories and redefine how business is conducted online. We believe smaller teams of exceptional talent will always prevail over larger teams with lower talent density. Proton has become profitable and reached scale without relying upon VC funding, largely due to superior talent that allows us to do things faster, more creatively, and more efficiently.

We have a global mindset and big ambitions but remain a start-up at heart. We value empowerment and flexibility and keep our structure flat to keep moving fast and avoid unnecessary politics. Tired of blending into the crowd? Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our social media pages
to learn more about us: Twitter, Reddit, Instagram.

The role:

You will be responsible for designing, building, maintaining and evolving the sync SDK powering Proton Drive's desktop applications. This includes not only building the application internals (managing and syncing local and remote state, performing cryptographic operations, etc) but also helping us to build resilient, scalable applications (graceful degradation; log and metrics streams free of personally identifiable information). You will be involved in the entire application lifecycle, but with a strong focus on the internals shared amongst our desktop applications, including Gitlab configuration, deployments, monitoring and alerting, and operational incident response. While this position is not a "full-stack" position, you will be expected to collaborate with backend engineers to drive any necessary changes and/or new features needed for the core of our desktop experience.

What you will do:

Be part of a small team working to bring a "privacy by default" solution to our Drive clients on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Develop applications that delight a wide range of users, from layperson to technical, and gives confidence that their online privacy is in good hands - while getting the complexity of end-to-end encryption out of the way.
Invest in test automation to improve the team's productivity and software delivery cadence.
Think critically on how to divide problems into iterations of simpler, composable solutions. Re-evaluate the minimum scope as necessary to meet objectives on-time.
Insist on high standards for application monitoring and alerting, in order to ensure a smooth customer experience at all times.

We are looking for:

Strong experience in .NET development
Strong experience with concurrent multi-threaded programming
Optional experience building and maintaining desktop applications
Working knowledge of file systems
Working knowledge of Git
Bachelor's or master’s degree in a relevant field of study
Experience with owning and maintaining large software components
Experience with gradual rollouts and metrics/monitoring/alerting frameworks

Even if you don’t meet all the requirements listed above, but feel you could still be a great fit, please still apply.

What We Offer

Office First: Collaboration is easier and more effective in person, which is why we have offices in Geneva, Zurich, Prague, Barcelona, Paris, London, Vilnius, Skopje, and Taipei. You can also enjoy working from home up to 30% of the time, while enjoying great company during our three core days in the office.
Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals.
Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.
Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.
Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.
Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.
Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning.
Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs.
Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do. Read more about our impact here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.

To learn more about our privacy policy, please visit our privacy policy page .

At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger- and moving faster. Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.

The Role

As a Software Architect / Solutions Architect
at Air Apps, you will be responsible for defining and overseeing the overall system architecture
for our AI-powered platform. You will collaborate with engineering teams, product managers, and stakeholders to design scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions
that align with business objectives.

You will play a key role in shaping our technology strategy, evaluating new tools and frameworks, and ensuring best practices

Define and maintain the overall architecture and system design for scalable and efficient software solutions.

Work closely with DevOps and SRE teams to ensure smooth deployment and operational reliability.
Establish coding and architecture standards, ensuring maintainability and scalability of codebases.
Identify and mitigate technical risks, ensuring system resilience and future scalability.

Requirements

Around 6+ years of experience in software development and architecture.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

Visual Studio Code is where millions of developers turn ideas into working software. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer in Zurich to tackle hard product and platform challenges as VS Code and GitHub Copilot continue to reshape how developers build software.

You will help to evolve VS Code as a market leading developer environment, seamlessly connecting its editor, agentic coding abilities, platform and extension ecosystem. You will identify where investment matters, prove difficult ideas in code, and establish approaches that multiple teams can build on. This is hands-on technical leadership: the opportunity to change both what developers can accomplish and what our engineering teams can deliver.

About The Team

We work in the open, with direct feedback from developers and extension authors. You will partner with engineers, designers, researchers, and product leaders across our team, GitHub, and Microsoft. We combine community feedback, research, experiments, and engineering judgment to decide what to build. Performance, accessibility, extensibility, security, and developer control are part of the product, not finishing touches.

Examples of work

The role spans core VS Code and Copilot; illustrative projects include:

Address architectural bottlenecks in large workspaces, proving an approach in code that multiple feature teams can adopt.
Define extension or workspace APIs that unlock new capabilities while preserving compatibility with existing extensions and remote development environments.
Prototype how developers delegate, review, and validate work with Copilot, then establish the product and platform boundaries needed to ship it.
Reshape and support our engineering process with custom solutions fine-tuned for throughput and quality.

Responsibilities

Identify significant product opportunities and systemic engineering problems; set technical direction that balances near-term delivery with long-term product and platform health.
Prove approaches through prototypes, critical implementation, testing, and difficult debugging, using hands-on work to guide architectural decisions.
Lead cross-team delivery across Microsoft and GitHub, resolving architectural disagreements, clarifying ownership and API boundaries, and enabling teams to deliver independently.
Own outcomes beyond release, using adoption, quality signals, evaluations, experiments, and user feedback to guide investment and adjust course.
Improve engineering effectiveness across teams through testing strategies, performance work, shared design patterns, and tools for rapid, reliable experimentation.
Lead technical discussions in the open, investigate community-reported issues, and work directly with developers and extension authors to shape designs.
Mentor experienced engineers and technical leaders, helping them develop judgment and take ownership without making yourself a bottleneck.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams, including setting direction, building alignment, and delivering substantial initiatives without relying on reporting-line authority.
Solid hands-on coding and design skills, with the ability to become productive in large TypeScript and Rust codebases.
Experience designing shared platforms, APIs, or large application architectures, with sound judgment about extensibility, compatibility, performance, and maintainability.
Solid product judgment, including identifying opportunities, setting priorities amid ambiguity, and turning technical decisions into practical designs and measurable improvements for users.
A track record of mentoring experienced engineers and improving the effectiveness of teams beyond your immediate area.
Clear communication skills, including explaining complex technical decisions and navigating tradeoffs with engineering and product partners.

Preferred Qualifications

We welcome a range of product backgrounds; these are helpful experiences, not a checklist. Previous work on developer tools, open-source projects, or AI products is not required.

Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

Experience evolving interactive products with attention to usability and accessibility.

Experience establishing experimentation and feedback practices that connect engineering decisions to user outcomes.
Practical familiarity with AI coding tools and sound judgment about where they help, where they fall short, and how they change development workflows.
Experience providing technical leadership on AI-powered products, open-source projects, or extensible applications.

, una empresa tecnológica española fundada en 2003, con sede corporativa en León y oficinas en Valladolid, Madrid, y Londres. Hemos participado en más de 500 proyectos para organizaciones líderes en banca, seguros, telecomunicaciones, energía y salud a nivel internacional.

. Somos más de 140 personas con pasión por el software de alta complejidad técnica, por aprender continuamente y por trabajar en proyectos con impacto real. Trabajamos con marcos de trabajo ágiles e integramos la IA
como herramienta cotidiana, con un enfoque ético y responsable. Contamos con el respaldo tecnológico de Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Atlassian y OutSystems
, y con 6 certificaciones ISO que avalan nuestros procesos.

No es casualidad: llevamos 23 años demostrando que desde aquí se puede trabajar para el mundo.

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos Senior .NET Engineer
para trabajar en un entorno en continua mejora y evolución tecnológica en León o Valladolid.

Tu día a día se desarrollará en un contexto de vanguardia:

Spec-Driven Development (SDD):
antes de escribir código, definimos lo que el sistema debe hacer. En este rol elaborarás especificaciones detalladas (requisitos funcionales, arquitectura y comportamiento esperado) antes de codificar.
Desarrollo asistido por IA:
uso habitual de Visual Studio / VS Code con Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor o similares en todo el ciclo, con criterio para evaluar lo que generan.
IA agéntica y Claude Skills:
usarás Claude Skills y MCP en el ciclo de desarrollo.
DevOps y CI/CD:
pipelines automatizados (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) y mejora constante del ciclo de entrega.
Stack tecnológico:
el lenguaje es lo de menos… En este proyecto: C#, .NET (8 o superior), ASP.NET Core (Web API), Entity Framework Core, SQL Server y Microsoft Azure, además de la evolución de aplicaciones en .NET Framework.
Calidad:
responsable de la calidad de tu código y referencia para el equipo: pruebas unitarias, de integración y funcionales (xUnit/NUnit), Clean Code, SOLID y code reviews.
Infraestructura como código:
Terraform, Ansible o Bicep.

¿Qué perfil necesitamos?

Formación:
Grado en Ingeniería Informática o titulación similar.
Experiencia:
al menos 3 años desarrollando software con tecnologías .NET en proyectos reales, con capacidad para afrontar retos complejos de forma autónoma.
Skills técnicos:
C# y .NET moderno, APIs REST con ASP.NET Core, EF Core y SQL; patrones de diseño, POO, Clean Code y SOLID.
SDD:
capacidad para elaborar especificaciones detalladas antes de codificar.
Desarrollo asistido por IA:
uso habitual y con criterio de modelos de lenguaje, evaluando críticamente el código generado.
IA agéntica y Claude Skills:
conocimiento práctico de Skills y MCP.
Mentalidad ágil:
experiencia en Scrum/Kanban.

¿Qué habilidades adicionales pueden sumar valor a tu perfil?

Blazor o frameworks front-end (Angular, React).
Microservicios, mensajería (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ) y contenedores (Docker, Kubernetes).
Migración de .NET Framework (incluido VB.NET) a .NET moderno.
Certificaciones Microsoft (p. ej., Azure Developer Associate).
Capacidad para desenvolverte con soltura en inglés, abriendo puertas a proyectos y colaboraciones internacionales.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

🚀 Proyectos de alta complejidad técnica:
trabajamos en problemas de alta complejidad técnica para clientes muy exigentes. No es para todo el mundo, y eso también es parte de lo que nos define.
🤝 El equipo, primero:
el nivel técnico de las personas con las que trabajarás es, probablemente, lo primero que nota quien llega. Aprenderás de tus compañeros/as porque saben más que tú en algo, y ellos aprenderán de ti en otra cosa. Esa densidad técnica no es casual.
💡 Siempre a la última, antes que el resto:
no llegamos a las tecnologías cuando ya son mainstream. Las adoptamos, las debatimos y las aplicamos en proyectos reales antes que la mayoría. Si tienes curiosidad técnica, aquí siempre hay algo nuevo en lo que crecer.
⚡ Sin jerarquías, sin intermediarios:
somos una empresa sin jerarquías. Las decisiones se toman con las personas adecuadas, de forma directa y sin intermediarios.
🧠 IA como ventaja, no como moda:
incorporamos inteligencia artificial de forma práctica en nuestros proyectos y en nuestra forma de trabajar. Tendrás acceso a herramientas como GitHub Copilot o Claude, formación real sobre cómo usarlas con criterio y la posibilidad de contribuir a proyectos donde la IA no es un extra, sino parte del núcleo.
🕐 Flexibilidad que se cumple:
horario flexible y modelo híbrido. Jornada intensiva todos los viernes del año, más julio y agosto completos. 22 días de vacaciones, y el 24 y el 31 de diciembre libres, siempre.
💰 Retribución competitiva:
salario alineado con el mercado y revisado según tu evolución real. Retribución flexible en restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación para que optimices lo que más te conviene.
🩺 Salud y bienestar:
seguro médico y dental, plan corporate en centros deportivos y torneos internos para los que quieran competir o simplemente desconectar.
🎁 Y los detalles también importan:
Welcome pack, cesta de Navidad, eventos de equipo y portal de descuentos exclusivo.

Nuestro compromiso:
tendrás respuesta en menos de una semana, independientemente del resultado.

Signicat is a pioneering Pan-European Digital Identity Service Provider, supporting over 170 data sources for seamless identity verification. Trusted by governments, financial institutions, and businesses worldwide. Such as General Financing, Compensa Life, Telia, Rimi, Volvo, and many more.

Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale.

Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world.

Since 2007, Signicat has been steadily growing organically and through strategic acquisitions, which led us to become a pioneering Pan-European Digital Identity Service Provider (DISP). We support 170+ data sources to identify businesses and individuals – from national eIDs, ID-document scanning, and biometric verification to data sources for AML and KYC checks, all accessible through a single integration point.

The Role

As a hands-on Engineering Manager, you will combine Java programming with engineering and technical leadership for one of our teams working in the domain of Identity Proofing. You will be responsible for growing and supporting the team, driving delivery, prioritizing the roadmap and backlog together with the Product Owner and other stakeholders, and balancing new capabilities with reliability, operational excellence, and technical debt.

The team is currently working on Signicat's next-generation offering for Identity Proofing by orchestrating several means available in the Signicat portfolio, such as NFC chip reading and live video identifications, in order to satisfy the highest compliance requirements in the market for financial services and similar.

How You'll Make An Impact

Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Drive the evolution of Signicat's Identity Proofing platform, ensuring it remains secure, scalable, reliable, and ready for future growth.
Collaborate closely with architects, engineering teams, and stakeholders across the company to deliver capabilities that satisfy ever-changing market needs.
Guide architectural and technical decisions within the team while promoting engineering best practices, observability, automation, and operational excellence.

Why We'll Love You

You are an experienced engineering leader who enjoys building high-performing teams as much as building great technology.
You have a strong software engineering background and are comfortable discussing architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native platforms with experienced engineers.
You thrive at the intersection of engineering and product, translating business needs into technical priorities and delivery plans.
You are an excellent communicator who builds trusted relationships with engineers, architects, and business stakeholders alike.
You bring deep expertise in the Java ecosystem, enabling you to provide strong technical leadership, mentor developers, and guide architectural decisions for high-scale SaaS services.
You enjoy coaching others, creating clarity, and enabling teams to do their best work.

Why You'll Love Working at Signicat

We Are Committed To Creating a Supportive, Inclusive, And Empowering Environment Where You Can Do Your Best Work And Grow Your Career. We Offer

Exceptional Work-Life Balance: Enjoy 5 paid days off each year on top of your 25 annual holiday allowance, plus a flexible, hybrid work schedule that trusts you to manage your time.
Estoril: Modern workplace - our residential-style Estoril office, conveniently near a train station, blends a relaxed seaside ambience with a cosy, tech-filled workspace. Featuring chill-out zones, a garden, and proximity to the beach, it's the perfect place to work and unwind
Work from Anywhere: Experience our international culture firsthand with the opportunity to work from any other Signicat office for 2 months per year and from any European country for 3 weeks per year.

Health & Wellness: We support your well-being with a dedicated wellness package and complimentary access to the Headspace app for mental health and mindfulness.
Your Tech, Your Way: Choose the laptop and tech gear that you are most comfortable and productive with.
A Truly International Team: Join a diverse and welcoming community with active Employee Resource Groups, including Women in Signicat and our LGBTQ+ group.

We're a dynamic community of passionate professionals dedicated to digital identity solutions.

Since our founding, we have grown and evolved through organic growth, strategic acquisitions, and continuous innovations.

This makes Signicat an exciting and ever-changing environment to be a part of!

new_jobs.title: Integration Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Heb jij ervaring met cloud-native architecturen en integratieoplossingen en wil jij jouw (AI) kennis inzetten om innovatieve oplossingen te realiseren? Dan zoeken wij jou als Integration Software Developer binnen ons Integratie Team bij Rensa Family Company.

Rensa Family Company is een groeiende organisatie binnen de technische groothandel waar efficiëntie en innovatie centraal staan. Als Software Developer werk je mee aan de doorontwikkeling van ons Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP). Dit platform speelt een belangrijke rol in het verbinden van onze IT-systemen en het ondersteunen van onze bedrijfsprocessen.

Jouw expertise zorgt ervoor dat we ons integratielandschap moderniseren en toekomstbestendig maken. Samen met het team ontwikkel je oplossingen voor complexe IT-vraagstukken en help je onze organisatie verder te digitaliseren.

Wat doet het Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP)?

Het Hybrid Integration Platform is ontworpen om applicaties op een gestandaardiseerde, schaalbare en onderhoudbare manier te integreren. Het biedt een cloud-native foundation die zowel cloud-based als on-premise systemen bindt in een event-driven architectuur.
Met technologieën zoals Azure Service Bus, Docker, ASP.NET Core Web API en Azure Functions, helpt HIP ons om integratiecomplexiteit te verminderen, ontwikkelingscycli te versnellen en flexibele samenwerking tussen onze systemen mogelijk te maken.

Jouw rol als Engineer

Als Integration Software Engineer draag je verantwoordelijkheid voor:
Ontwerp en ontwikkeling: Het ontwerpen, realiseren en optimaliseren van HIP-componenten zoals adapters, services en event-driven messaging.
Samenwerking binnen het team: Je werkt nauw samen met collega-developers, architecten en andere stakeholders om kwalitatieve integratieoplossingen te realiseren.
Standaardisatie en kwaliteit: Je ontwikkelt oplossingen volgens de geldende integratiestandaarden, waaronder het gebruik van het Rensa Data Model (RDM) en Canonical Data Models.
Samenwerking met business en IT-stakeholders: Je vertaalt zakelijke behoeften naar technische oplossingen en werkt samen aan het verbeteren van processen en technologieën
Continue verbetering: Je blijft op de hoogte van ontwikkelingen binnen integratie- en cloudtechnologieën en draagt actief bij aan het verbeteren van bestaande oplossingen en ontwikkelprocessen.
Toepassen van AI: Je zet AI-tools in om ontwikkeling, testen, documentatie en analyse van integratieoplossingen efficiënter en kwalitatief beter uit te voeren.
Testen en beheer: Je bent betrokken bij het testen, documenteren, monitoren en onderhouden van integratieoplossingen om een stabiele en betrouwbare dienstverlening te waarborgen.

Technologieën waarmee je gaat werken

.NET (C#)
Azure Service Bus
Azure API Management
Azure Functions
ASP.NET Web API
Azure CosmosDB
Azure Storage-accounts
Azure SQL
Azure Container Apps
Docker (en Kubernetes via Azure Container Apps Environment)
KEDA voor event-driven autoscaling
Azure DevOps
AI tooling: GitHub, Copilot, chatGPT, Codex etc.

Wat maakt jou een goede kandidaat om ons team te versterken?

(Ruime) ervaring met softwareontwikkeling, bij voorkeur in .NET (C#);
Ervaring met het Azure platform en Azure Services zoals Service Bus, API Management, CosmosDB, Storage Accounts en Functions;
Het begrijpen en toepassen van containertechnologieën (bijv. Docker) en cloud-native principes;
Kennis van event-driven architecturen en publish/subscribe messaging;
Ervaring met het implementeren en beheren van RESTful APIs en API-gateways.

new_jobs.title: System Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Wil jij je technische talent inzetten om een maatschappelijke bijdrage te leveren aan de zorg? Word jij enthousiast van het bouwen aan de infrastructuur, koppelingen en cloud-omgevingen die de zorg écht slimmer maken? Lees dan verder, want bij Bince doe je dit elke dag.

Functieomschrijving

Wat ga je doen?

Als System Engineer zorg jij ervoor dat onze technische infrastructuur en koppelingen stabiel, veilig en schaalbaar blijven draaien. Je ontwikkelt nieuwe koppelingen en ontsluit systemen voor klanten, en je bouwt en beheert onze Infrastructure as Code. Wanneer er problemen ontstaan, zoals koppelingen die niet werken, toegangsproblemen of ontbrekende functionaliteiten, pak jij deze ad hoc op en voer je het incident- en changemanagement uit.

Jij zet de ruwe data in de database klaar zodat de Data Engineer hiermee verder kan werken, en je stemt dit af met de Data Engineers en de BI-consultants. Je zorgt dat de VM's elke nacht blijven draaien en werkt dagelijks in Azure, waar je resources aanmaakt die vervolgens door het team worden gebruikt. Je kent de BinceBase codebase, gebruikt deze en ontwikkelt deze verder door: je breidt het platform uit met nieuwe functionaliteiten en koppelingen, optimaliseert bestaande omgevingen en tools, en ontdekt en implementeert nieuwe systemen.

Je bent alert op mogelijkheden om efficiënter te werken: je automatiseert repeterende taken van collega's, houdt de kostenefficiëntie in Azure scherp in de gaten en verbetert de stabiliteit van onze omgevingen. Je kent de beschikbare technische toolbox en het informatiemodel (de architectuur) en past dit toe. Daarnaast consulteer en voed je de CTO, en ben je het aanspreekpunt voor collega's en externe partijen (zoals klanten en leveranciers) op jouw vakgebied. Je bent ondersteunend bij tweedelijnsincidenten, lost problemen op waar collega's of klanten mee komen en zorgt dat de systemen stabiel blijven. Bij afwezigheid van de System Administrator pak jij de taken van deze functie op indien nodig.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent in de eerste plaats een technische probleemoplosser met hart voor stabiele, veilige systemen. Je krijgt energie van het bouwen, optimaliseren en bewaken van infrastructuur en koppelingen. Je werkt gestructureerd en zelfstandig, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op met je team en de CTO als dat nodig is.

Harde eisen voor deze functie zijn:

Aantoonbare ervaring met cloudplatformen zoals Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud of AWS
Ervaring met versiebeheer (GIT)
Ervaring met het ontsluiten van bronnen, onder andere via API's
Ervaring met PowerShell of Bash
Ervaring met Python

Het is een pré als je ervaring hebt met:

SQL
Bicep (Infrastructure as Code)

Bij Bince staan de volgende competenties centraal:

Betrouwbaarheid
Je bent iemand op wie we kunnen bouwen. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van je werk, documenteert je werkzaamheden op goede wijze en zorgt dat systemen blijven doen wat ze moeten doen.

Nieuwsgierigheid
Je signaleert kansen voor doorontwikkeling en innovatie van BinceBase en onze techniek, en bent gedreven om jezelf en je kennis up-to-date te houden.

Zelfstandigheid en samenwerking
Je kunt goed schakelen tussen meerdere taken en stelt de juiste prioriteiten, die je periodiek afstemt met de CTO en de Manager Operations. Je bent een teamplayer die goed samenwerkt met je team en de klant, maar ook prima zelfstandig je werkzaamheden verricht.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:

Dat de data elke nacht binnenkomt, zodat data van de gemaakte koppelingen elke nacht actueel is
Het optimaliseren van de snelheid en stabiliteit van de nachtelijke verversingen
Het bouwen en beheren van technische oplossingen volgens de beschikbare richtlijnen en documentatie, en het signaleren van verbeteringen bij de CTO
Het volgen van kansen voor innovatie en doorontwikkeling van bestaande oplossingen, en het doorvoeren hiervan met de juiste documentatie en communicatie
Het beheren en uitvoeren van je eigen taken in DevOps
De beveiliging van bestaande en toekomstige oplossingen

Waar kom je te werken?

Bince is een vooruitstrevend bedrijf dat zich inzet om de zorg slimmer te maken met behulp van data. We zien dat de zorgsector onder druk staat: de vraag stijgt, terwijl het aantal zorgverleners daalt. Wij geloven dat goede data toepassingen helpen om die kloof te overbruggen en daar werken we elke dag aan.

Je komt terecht in een multidisciplinair team van 23 collega's: van BI-specialisten tot engineers, van sales tot management. Wat ons verbindt is de overtuiging dat data het verschil kan maken. We werken hybride, met veel onderlinge samenwerking én ruimte voor jouw inbreng.

We leren continu, blijven onszelf ontwikkelen en helpen elkaar vooruit; net zoals we dat voor onze klanten doen.

Primaire arbeidsvoorwaarden

Salarisrange: €4.000 – €5.500 bruto per maand (afhankelijk van ervaring)
Fulltime dienstverband (32 tot 40 uur bespreekbaar)
8% vakantiegeld
Hybride werken: gedeeltelijk thuis en op ons mooie kantoor in Assen
Een fijne balans tussen vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid

Secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden

13e maand in december (naar rato dienstverband)
Pensioenregeling bij Allianz
Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of mogelijkheid tot leaseauto
MacBook & iPhone voor zakelijk gebruik
26 vakantiedagen o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband
Jaarlijks opleidingsbudget van €1.000 voor hard- en soft-skills
Regelmatig teamactiviteiten zoals sportieve activiteiten, vrijmibo's en weekendjes weg

Wat nu?

Wanneer jij jezelf herkent in de kennis en ervaring die wij zoeken om ons team te versterken, dan komen wij graag met je in contact!

Zo ziet het proces eruit:

Kennismaking : Onze recruiter Daniel neemt contact met je op voor een (online) gesprek waarin we elkaar leren kennen.
Vervolggesprek : Bij wederzijds enthousiasme volgt een gesprek met Jelle (Manager Operations) en Eddy (CTO).
Inhoudelijk gesprek : Samen met Gjalt (System Engineer) en Dirk Jelle (System Engineer) duiken we de diepte in.
Aanbieding: Als de klik er is, volgt snel een aanbod en bespreken we de arbeidsvoorwaarden persoonlijk.

We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten!

Heb je vragen over de vacature? Neem dan contact op met Daniel op 06-23509116 of danielgerzee@bince.nl.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van onze vacatures wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Today, Jumbo operates across Australia, the UK, Canada and the US, bringing together technology, creativity and purpose to create premium digital experiences people love.

Based in Galgate, StarVale is dedicated to strengthening the fundraising power of charities, not‑for‑profits, and hospices across the UK. We combine specialist lottery management with a genuine commitment to helping organisations maximise their impact, so more communities receive the support they deserve.

What will you be doing?

We’re looking for a .NET Web Developer to join us in this hands‑on build‑and‑migrate role. You will be rewriting existing PHP websites in .NET, integrating them with our business systems, and helping shape how we structure our shared architecture going forward. Working closely with cross‑functional teams, you will support day‑to‑day business needs, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to high‑quality engineering practices through code reviews, documentation, and collaborative solution design.

What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Your daily work will centre on maintaining, modernising, and progressively transforming our legacy .NET systems while supporting the smooth running of core business operations across StarVale. You can expect to:

Design and build ASP.NET Core websites targeting modern .NET versions (including .NET 10)
Migrate Laravel and CodeIgniter sites to the .NET platform while preserving functionality, SEO, and data integrity
Work with Umbraco CMS — extending existing implementations or building new sites where appropriate
Integrate websites with core .NET business systems and SQL Server databases
Write and maintain EF Core data access code, including migrating data from MySQL to SQL Server
Document business logic and edge cases from existing PHP sites before decommissioning
Contribute to shared architecture decisions, internal libraries, and coding standards
Write clean, tested, maintainable code and participate in code reviews

What You’ll Be Able to Bring to the Role

Essential

Solid commercial experience with C# and ASP.NET Core (or strong ASP.NET MVC experience with a clear path to Core)
Experience with Entity Framework Core (or EF) and relational databases (SQL Server)
Comfortable working with front-end fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) alongside server-rendered .NET views or Razor Pages
Experience migrating or integrating systems between different platforms or frameworks
Ability to read and understand PHP (Laravel and/or CodeIgniter) well enough to translate existing functionality into .NET — you won't be writing new PHP, but you'll need to understand what's there
Good understanding of web fundamentals: routing, authentication, forms, SEO basics (URL structure, redirects)

Mindset & Soft Skills

Migration Mindset: Confidence to evaluate legacy code, challenge outdated practices, and guide non-technical stakeholders through modernized technical solutions.
Problem Solver: Highly resourceful with strong initiative, able to own projects independently from requirements-gathering to deployment.
Communication: Excellent people skills to liaise effectively between technical teams, external auditors, and cross-departmental stakeholders.

Preferred

Experience with Umbraco CMS
Experience with Blazor
Familiarity with Azure or other cloud hosting for .NET applications
Experience leading or contributing to a platform migration or legacy system modernization
Understanding of REST API design, for connecting websites to internal business systems
Ability to work within agile environments, including Kanban and Sprints.

Salary Banding: £35,000–£45,000 per annum, depending on experience.

Our Ways of Working

At StarVale, we value balance and flexibility. You will be based in our office in Galgate, Lancaster. This role is a flexible hybrid, typically averaging 50% in the office (2-3 days per week). We prioritise results and collaborate to make sure everyone can contribute effectively, while enjoying flexibility and balance in how they work.

Why Join StarVale?

Find Your Freedom - https://bit.ly/Jumbointeractive

At StarVale, our team thrives because we invest in our people. Here’s what you can expect from us;

An annual regional bonus scheme that rewards your contributions, dependent on company performance.
25 days annual leave + public holidays + your birthday off.
Access to our Employee Assistance Program, providing counselling and coaching.
Reward & Recognition programme and length of service benefits.
The freedom to work from almost* anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks a year.

Candidates who are offered a position will be required to complete pre-employment checks through our partner, Checkmate, which will include referencing, Right to Work in the UK and DBS checks. We are, unfortunately, unable to offer sponsorship opportunities.

We are a 2026 Circle Back Initiative Gold Employer – we commit to respond to every applicant.

Jumbo Interactive is a diversified, technology-enabled lottery and prize draw company operating across Australia, the United Kingdom, and North America. Our vision is to be the heart of the world’s best winning experiences - and our mission is to create premium digital entertainment experiences that people love.

With operations across Australia, the UK, Canada and the United States, Jumbo has more than 300 employees and generated $1.125 billion in Total Transaction Value in FY26.
